title: Demand Planning Lead
description:
**Job Description**
**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible**
 You will oversee demand planning activities for your assigned product families in your business unit. You will also lead the demand review process and driving interactions with the cross\-functional teams.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
 You will:
   

  

* Lead the demand management agenda for the category, being the key interface between commercial (sales revenue planning) and supply (replenishment) to identify and evaluate the impact of potential availability issues/commercial changes including gap assessment and risk and opportunity discussions
* Partner with modelling team for the generation of statistical forecasting
* Manage, coach and develop a team
* Review standard consumption versus forecast at the customer and total product levels, liaising with replenishment and sales revenue planning to manage potential availability issues and the impact of under consumption
* Drive strong linkages with the commercial, customer collaboration, modelling, order fulfilment teams and supply planning including innovation and equity
* Drive continuous capability building in the demand planning team for planning improvement


**What You Will Bring**
 A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:
   

  

* Comprehensive supply chain, economic, financial or logistics experience and commercial awareness in a fast\-moving consumer goods or consumer packaged goods environment
* Open to learn new ways of working and is willing to use new tools
* Experience driving demand review and participation in an IBP cycle
* Able to influence cross\-functional teams, working on the key priorities and improving the plan
* Able to build effective teams
* Knowledge in leading practice demand planning and end\-to\-end supply chain concepts
* Excellent problem\-solving skills, analytical skills and verbal and written communication skills


**OVERALL Purpose**
 The Demand Planning Lead owns the
 **end\-to\-end demand planning and Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process** 
 , aligning commercial ambitions with operational capabilities. The role develops a
 **consensus\-driven demand plan** 
 across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Planning, Manufacturing and Procurement — enabling superior customer service, healthy inventory, improved
 **forecast accuracy** 
 and profitable growth. The role also champions
 **digital planning transformation** 
 through AI/ML\-enabled forecasting and advanced analytics platforms.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Enterprise Demand Planning \& Forecasting
* Own the end\-to\-end demand planning process across all product categories, channels and geographies
* Develop and maintain accurate statistical demand forecasts using AI/ML platforms, market intelligence and commercial inputs
* Drive consensus forecasting with Sales, Marketing, Finance and Supply Planning; continuously improve forecast accuracy, bias and demand variability
* Analyse demand trends, seasonality, promotional performance and market dynamics; deliver actionable insights for senior leadership
* IBP \& S\&OP Leadership
* Lead the monthly IBP cycle: Portfolio Review → Demand Review → Supply Review → Integrated Reconciliation → Management Business Review
* Facilitate executive alignment between demand, supply and financial commitments; drive risk management and timely decision\-making
* Lead monthly S\&OP governance forums; balance commercial opportunities against operational constraints; identify supply risks and mitigation plans
* Support short\-term demand and supply balancing through Sales \& Operations Execution (S\&OE)
* Portfolio \& Innovation Planning
* Partner with Marketing and Commercial teams to forecast new product launches, seasonal products and promotional campaigns
* Lead SKU lifecycle planning: phase\-ins, phase\-outs, rationalization and portfolio optimization
* Drive innovation forecast accuracy and on\-time new product launch readiness
* Supply Chain Performance \& Digital Transformation
* Improve customer service levels while optimizing inventory, working capital and minimizing write\-offs, excess and obsolete stock
* Champion SAP APO, SAP IBP, O9 or equivalent platforms; drive AI/ML forecasting adoption and planning transformation initiatives
* Collaborate with global/regional teams to enhance planning capability maturity and supply chain agility
* Stakeholder Management \& Team Leadership
* Build strong cross\-functional partnerships; influence senior leadership through data\-driven recommendations and business insights
* Present planning assumptions, risks and performance updates to leadership forums
* Lead, coach and develop the Demand Planning team; build a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement


**Experience Required**
* 10–15 years of progressive Supply Chain Planning experience in FMCG, Consumer Goods or related industries
* Proven leadership of Demand Planning \& IBP for large, complex, multi\-category businesses
* Strong hands\-on experience with S\&OP, cross\-functional planning, and digital planning implementations (SAP IBP/APO, O9 or similar)
* Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and driving planning transformation initiatives
* Track record of building and developing high\-performing planning teams


**Ideal Candidate Profile**
 A seasoned planning leader with a proven track record of enterprise
 **demand planning and IBP** 
 leadership in large FMCG or consumer products organizations.
   

  

 Deep expertise in
 **forecasting, S\&OP, supply chain analytics** 
 and digital planning platforms (
 **SAP IBP, SAP APO, O9** 
 ), combined with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
   

  

 A collaborative, transformation\-oriented leader who can
 **build capability, drive change** 
 and deliver sustainable supply chain performance improvements.
   

  

 Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy
   

  

**Business Unit Summary**
 Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth\-watering and well\-loved local and global brands such as
 *Cadbury* 
 chocolates,
 *Bournvita* 
 and
 *Tang* 
 powdered beverages,
 *Oreo* 
 and
 *Cadbury Bournvita* 
 biscuits, and
 *Halls* 
 and
 *Cadbury Choclairs Gold* 
 candies get safely into our customers hands—and mouths
 *.* 
 Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research \& Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. We are also proud to be recognised by Avatar as the Best Companies for Women in India in 2019 – the fourth time we’ve received this award.
   

  

 Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
   

  

**Job Type**
 Regular

title: Assistant Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
* To Assist in manage the operations of the Cash Management Operations i.e. Pre\-Processing, Processing (Payment and Clearing) and Static Data Unit (set up, maintenance, pricing, and billing, CoE, LM) in ensuring consistent delivery of high\-quality services to customers and meeting objectives set by the Group using available resources allocated while maintaining operational risk to an accepted level


**Key Responsibilities**
* To manage daily operations to achieve service quality by meeting / exceeding service standards and achieving zero defect for Cash Management Operations i.e., Pre\-Processing, Processing (Payment and Clearing), Investigation and Static Data Unit (set up, maintenance, pricing and billing, CoE, LM)
* To discharge operational duties of the Cash Management Operations i.e., Pre\-Processing, Processing (Payment and Clearing) and Static Data Unit (set up, maintenance, pricing and billing, CoE, LM), as instructed by the Manager of the Unit/ Head of Department and ensure that the established service standards are met
* Direct staff responsibilities as per current Organization Chart in Cash Management Operations i.e. Pre\-Processing, Processing (Payment and Clearing) and Static Data Unit (set up, maintenance, pricing, and billing, CoE, LM)


**Strategy**
* Manage teams in building a stronger relationship with our clients and customers.
* Manage initiatives to innovate and digitize their processes as well as intensifying collaboration across the network.
* To accelerate new generation of leaders.
* Manage all initiatives to get more fit and flexible in the way we work.
* Focus on proving that we are here for good


**Business**
* Maintain a close working relationship with the customers to ensure that service issues are promptly escalated and acted upon.
* Initiating \& implementing service quality initiatives
* Uphold the values of the Group and company at all times


**Processes**
* Ensuring continuous improvement in timeliness to the standards prescribed for the process from time to time.
* Releasing deals as per the department operating instruction manual, customers instructions and within the timeliness and accuracy standards specified.
* Ensuring compliance with all applicable Rules / Regulations and Company and Group Policies. Identifying exceptions from the norms \& initiating corrective and preventive actions.
* Comply with Group Money Laundering Prevention Policy and Procedures and Sanctions to the extend applicable and reporting all suspicious Transaction to the Line Manager.
* Where applicable, ensure compliance to Group and Country Regulations are managed to the extend agreed with the Countries and ensure all staff adhere to the same


**People \& Talent**
* Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
* Ensure provision of ongoing training and development, to larger teams and ensure that direct reports are suitably skilled and qualified with effective supervision in place to mitigate any risk.
* Employ, engage and retain high quality people.
* Set and monitor jib descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.
* Promoting an environment where all team members develop a sense of involvement in the conduct of their regular work and contribute ideas with the objective of achieving excellence in service quality


**Risk Management**
* Responsible for the Audit and Risk Control Standard associated with Cash Services operations.
* To ensure approved generic Product Programs and their corresponding Country Product Templates are in place before any product is accepted for implementation by Service Delivery. To refer any instances to Group Operations and CORG via KPIs and monthly risk exception reporting.
* To proactively monitor and manage operational risks, system risk and channel risk of the products and to highlight any potential and actual breakdown of controls to Group Operations and CORG via KPIs and risk exception reporting.
* Work with UORM to develop, design and implement control measures and monitoring plans for compliance and operational risk management
* Timely update of monitoring conducted in ORMA Optial Ensure risks and issues identified are resolved in an appropriate and timely manner


**Governance**
* Provide oversight across three hubs, ensuring compliance with the highest standards of regulatory and business conduct and compliance practices as defined by internal and external requirements. This includes compliance with local banking laws and anti\-money – laundering regulations and guidelines.
* Embed the Group’s values and code of conduct in SSC Cash to ensure that adherence with the highest standard of ethics, and compliance with relevant policies, processes and regulations among employees form part of the culture


**Regulatory \& Business Conduct**
* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.


**Key stakeholders**
* Country and GBS Stakeholders


**Other Responsibilities**
* To assist the manager in ensuring consistent delivery of high\-quality services to customers through meeting or exceeding customer expectation guided by the Service Level Agreement, efficiency/accuracy standards and good business processes/ judgment.
* Assisting the manager in leading the Cash Management Operations to achieve quality service by meeting the prescribed objectives and goals. Assist the Manager in overseeing the daily operations of the Payment team and contribute towards meeting the team’s objectives.
* Manage staff individual performance, against set objectives and providing the appropriate support, motivation and guidance to staff to achieve these objectives. Contribute to the development of associates by guiding, coaching, motivating, supporting and assisting selected number of associates.
* Primarily process within the TAT agreed with CPC in the SLA and also other functions as requested by the Manager/ Head of Department.
* Ensure that the set productivity targets (efficiency, accuracy, etc.), defect management and processing turnaround standards are achieved (within own area of responsibility).
* Ensure awareness and full compliance of all laid down rules, regulations, policies, guidelines, procedures, practices and code of conduct imposed by the Company/ Group.
* Verify transactions processed by Service Lead, Senior Global Operations Officer and Global Operations Officer and authorize those that fall within own\-delegated release authority. Checking of and/or approving customer payment order against Payment system.
* Establish and maintain close working relationship with appropriate persons in the Spoke countries, Group offices and within the Company itself to facilitate an open and direct communication of issues, needs, queries, etc. such that these may be responded to in an efficient, prompt and professional manner.
* Be guided accordingly and aware of the roles and responsibilities for anti\-money laundering prevention and sanctions related checking (i.e. Understanding the policy, reporting procedure and escalation procedure)
* Ensure due care and diligence is exercised on day\-to\-day operational matters relating to anti\-money laundering and Sanctions related checking, by acquiring relevant knowledge and training and provide support to superiors and subordinates.
* Conforming and adhering to the Team’s risk profile, by following the guidelines / policies / procedures stipulated for Operation Losses, Escalation Procedures, CMS Policies, and reconciliation of outstanding items, scanning, SCSTAR and end\-of\-day reports.
* Ensure that control and security policies / procedures governing all processes in the department are in place, implemented and reviewed (as and when necessary) and to ensure that these policies / procedures not only continue to be relevant and effective in mitigating risk, but also supports the need for high operational efficiency and excellent customer service
* Ensure that all staff of the department continues to be equipped and developed with the necessary knowledge, skills and tools to achieve the required level of competency to facilitate them to perform their roles and responsibilities effectively, efficiently and accurately.
* Facilitate the building of a performance\-driven organization by setting SMART objectives, constantly reviewing the dept’s and individual performance against these objectives and providing the appropriate support, motivation and guidance to staff to achieve these objectives.
* Responsible for succession planning for key positions, managing the attrition of employees and ensuring that a plan is developed and executed for high potential individuals in the department.
* Contribute towards the future strategic direction and process innovation of Payment by keeping abreast of changes in customer needs, technology and business environment and taking pro\-active steps to embrace and capitalize on these changes.
* Any ad\-hoc roles changes will require Head of Department or Manager’s approval before assuming new role temporarily or permanently in line with segregation of duties.


**Key Measurables**
* Achieves the processing turnaround standards as stipulated in the Service Level Agreement between the dept. and various Spoke countries.
* Meeting productivity standards in terms of processing efficiency and accuracy of output.
* Support the roll\-out of appropriate quality management systems and achieving the quality objectives and standards set.
* Coaching the Cash Management Operation team members to achieve the desired level of productivity and competency. To ensure team members adhere closely to their Learning \& Development plans, in achieving a fully competent, engaged and results driven team.
* Contributing ideas for improvement on processes, procedures, end\-to\-end processing, etc. to team management
* Manage operational risk appropriately to avoid any operational and/or reputational losses to the Company / Group


**Skills And Experience**
* Banking Products
* Branch Banking Systems
* Data Gathering and Analysis


**Qualifications**
* Academic or Professional Education/Qualifications: University educated
* Licenses and Certifications/accreditations: nonadditional
* Professional Memberships: relevant memberships to be agreed
* Bank training: nonadditional
* Languages: English


**About Standard Chartered**
 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. * Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term


**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,** 
 we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
   

  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time\-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.

title: Production Supervisor
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
   

  

 We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
   

  

 Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs.
   

  

 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 The Global Payment Operations (GPO) organization delivers global wire transfers and ACH payments for internal and external bank clients and supports end\-to\-end payment execution and investigations for transactions initiated through various channels. The team also provides sanctions screening on transactions for multiple products, in accordance with policies established by the Global Economic Sanctions Compliance team.
   

  

 Global Payments Support \& Enablement (GPSE) CoE is responsible for various Testing / Change Management engagements encompassing Payment platforms for EMEA, APAC, US and Canada regions. GPSE resources ensure Enterprise Change documentation and procedures are followed for compliance to the Change MRA2 governance.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This job is responsible for managing medium to large projects for an operations department or Line of Business. Key responsibilities include coordinating execution across stakeholders and test groups, managing project scope, planning, organizing and governing the test execution and working closely with management on project impact and direction. Job expectations include acting as the first point of contact for end\-to\-end project status, project health, mitigation, and timely escalation to leadership and stakeholders. They will also define the project scope to others outside of operations that may become involved in or impacted by the project. This role requires a thorough knowledge of the operations area to be able to assess and analyze the impact of new initiatives to the team.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Manages and directs project parameters, costs, project testing execution, and resource allocation.
* Partners with operations management on creating project impact and providing direction and guidance to internal teams.
* Coordinates development of key project deliverables in partnership with various key internal and external business partners
* Manages and leads the execution of multiple and often competing priorities to meet deadlines and adhere with policies and procedures.
* Establishes project status routines and tracks critical path deadlines and overall business measures for success.
* Leads defect resolution and roadblock clearing efforts to enable successful completion of testing.
* Acting as the primary point of contact and integration for the assigned projects
* Driving the end\-to\-end integration of various work streams to deliver the intended project solution, including requirements gathering, data mapping, project execution, integration and implementation.
* Coordinating execution, manage project scope, planning, organizing and governing the test execution
* Obtaining and aligning resources to key project roles
* Directing the work efforts of resources that may be functionally aligned as part of the project.
* Managing the project scope, timeline and budget/expenses
* Establishing clearly defined responsibilities and accountabilities across project participants
* Leading risk management and mitigation planning readiness, change adoption, stakeholder management, and quality assurance.
* Ensuring all applicable change requirements are satisfied.


**Requirements\***
* Minimum of 3 years of experience with projects, production support activities and/or payment operations
* Cross functional with strong business analysis, problem solving, quality management and organization skills
* Skilled in translating business requirements into technical requirements
* Strives to bring new thoughts and ideas to teams to drive innovation and unique solutions.
* Experience in connecting with a diverse set of clients to understand future business needs – is a continuous learner.
* Participate in and drive collaborative efforts to advance tools, technology, and ways of working to better serve an evolving client base.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Willing to learn and adapt to change.
* Ability to understand the bigger picture (risks, dependencies)


**Education\***
 Certifications If Any
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 12\-15 years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Projects, production support activities and/or payment operations
* Change \& Project Management
* Collaboration
* Risk Management
* Customer \& Client Focus
* Planning \& Problem Solving


**Desired Skills**
* Experience of the Agile software delivery methodology
* Experience with large scale projects/project management
* Executive reporting and presentation skills
* Working on JIRA and other project management tools


**Work Timings\***
 12:30 to 21:30 (9 hours)
   

  

**Job Location\***
 Chennai

title: Assistant / Deputy Manager – OFR Field Operations
description:
**About Ocean Freight Operations**
 The Ocean Freight Operations team plays a pivotal role in managing all ocean\-bound imports and exports, utilizing a diverse range of equipment and services. The team collaborates closely with a network of ocean carriers, Procurement \& capacity management (PCM), and participating in major carrier alliances to secure planned space protection from key container ports globally. This meticulous coordination is essential for ensuring a reliable and efficient transportation process for ocean\-bound cargo.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As an integral part of Ocean Freight Field Operations, this role involves liaising with Shipping lines and customs authorities to facilitate the timely arrival and departure of cargo, supporting import and export operations at DGF’s Satellite locations. The incumbent will play a crucial role in maintaining high standards of service delivery, fostering relationships with stakeholders, and contributing to the overall success of the ocean freight operations team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Operational Excellence:**
* Ensure cost\-effective, high\-quality import/export ocean freight operations at satellite locations.
* Procure and manage cargo capacity cost\-effectively, overseeing all port operations.
* Ensure operational compliance and error\-free documentation.
* Coordinate all physical handling activities at CFS, adhering to regulations and internal procedures in line with the Quality \& Environment Management Systems.
* Align processes to deliver as per customer requirements.
* Provide guidelines to CFS to ensure handling operations are consistent with the group's business strategy.
* Vendor management and Timeliness through CW1\.
* Monitor quality and adherence to standards, responsible for continuous improvement and optimization of product means.
* Monitor and control costs, implementing cost improvement levers.
* Develop a high\-performance service culture within the CFS.
* Drive implementation of key initiatives.
* Coordinate with transporters for timely placement/delivery of containers to avoid detention/storage costs.
* Monitor/handle hub movements for ICD as per the defined schedule.
* Ensure timely filing of SMTP with customs for hinterland shipments.
* Arrange containers required for hub stuffing and ensure proper stuffing is done.
* Maintain stuffing/destuffing photographs.
* Stay updated on regulatory changes with Customs/CFS.
* Manage CFS vendor payment processes.
* Taking complete responsibility for independently managing customer accounts, guided by both supervisor and manager, following the 'one file, one operator' approach.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Increase customer satisfaction with best\-in\-class services.
* Interface with the sales team.


**COMPETENCIES**
**Functional Competencies**
* Product Knowledge: Thorough knowledge of the entire operational flow from booking to documentation and customs clearance, ensuring efficient and timely movement.
* Customer Service: Strong customer service skills to address inquiries, provide updates, and resolve issues related to shipments.
* Technology Proficiency: Implementing CW1 and other tools for optimizing operations.
* Customs Regulations Acumen: Understanding of customs procedures, tariff and international trade laws for industry regulations and standards.
* Cargo Handling Expertise: Manage cargo handling processes, including loading, and unloading.


**Behavioural Competencies**
* Agility: Ability to adapt quickly to changing operational needs and environments.
* Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and improve skills to enhance performance.
* Attention to Detail: Consistently maintaining accuracy and precision in tasks and documentation.
* Quality Orientation: Commitment to delivering high\-quality results and services.
* Initiative: Taking proactive steps to improve processes or address issues without waiting for direction.


**WHO CAN APPLY?**
**Must Have**
* 2\-3 years of experience in the shipping/logistics industry for Executive/Sr. Exec.
* 4\-6 years of experience in the shipping/logistics industry for AM/DM
* Bachelor’s degree in any field required.
* Proven experience in running smooth operations processes.
* Basic problem\-solving skills to address common challenges.
* Proficient in Email writing and verbal communication with internal and external coordination.


**Qualified freshers are welcome.**

title: Lending Ops Subject Matter Expert analyst

title: Associate Vice President
description:
**Job Summary**
**Role Purpose**
* To provide strategic leadership and end\-to\-end oversight of Accounts Payable and Payment Operations within Organization, ensuring delivery of efficient, controlled, compliant, and customer\-centric services across the organization.
* The role is accountable for operational excellence, governance, risk management, payment controls, stakeholder engagement, process transformation, and people leadership. The Associate Vice President will lead multiple teams through senior managers and managers, drive continuous improvement initiatives, strengthen the control environment, and ensure alignment with Standard Chartered strategic priorities, values, and risk culture.
* The role serves as a key partner to global stakeholders across Finance, Procurement, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Business functions to ensure sustainable operational performance, scalability, and service excellence.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the end\-to\-end design and implementation of the P\-Card programme across approved markets, from business case and operating model through rollout and stabilisation.
* Translate the P\-Card strategy into a phased implementation roadmap with clear scope, milestones, dependencies, benefits, risks and accountable owners.
* Own delivery governance, including programme plans, steering updates, decision logs, risk and issue tracking, and timely escalation of delivery constraints.
* Define the target operating model covering card request, approval, issuance, activation, usage, expense submission, reconciliation, settlement, suspension and closure.
* Partner with Procurement, Finance, Treasury, Tax, Legal, Compliance, Operational Risk, Technology, Information Security and business teams to deliver market\-ready solutions.
* Lead engagement with card issuers, expense\-platform providers and other external partners, ensuring service, control, data and implementation requirements are met.
* Develop and maintain P\-Card policies, standards, procedures, user guidance and control requirements aligned with organisational and local regulatory expectations.
* Establish robust maker\-checker controls, approval limits, merchant\-category restrictions, transaction limits and segregation of duties across the card lifecycle.
* Design preventive and detective controls for inappropriate spend, duplicate claims, split transactions, personal usage, cash withdrawal and other policy exceptions.
* Ensure cardholder, approver, administrator and programme\-owner responsibilities are clearly defined, communicated and evidenced.
* Oversee integration between the card issuer, expense\-management platform, procurement systems, enterprise resource planning systems and general ledger.
* Ensure accurate accounting, cost allocation, statement matching, settlement, reconciliation and month\-end reporting for P\-Card transactions.
* Define data, reporting and dashboard requirements covering spend, adoption, exceptions, ageing, delinquency, control breaches, savings and supplier coverage.
* Lead user acceptance testing, defect management, production\-readiness reviews, cutover planning and post\-implementation validation.
* Coordinate market onboarding, including local requirements assessment, stakeholder sign\-off, communications, training and hypercare support.
* Drive cardholder and approver adoption while maintaining appropriate eligibility criteria, approval discipline and spend governance.
* Act as the senior escalation point for implementation decisions, operational incidents, issuer performance, control gaps and complex stakeholder concerns.
* Ensure timely investigation, remediation and root\-cause analysis of failed transactions, unreconciled items, suspicious activity and policy breaches.
* Maintain complete documentation and audit trails for programme decisions, approvals, testing, controls, exceptions and issue remediation.
* Support internal and external audits, regulatory reviews and risk assessments, ensuring actions are resolved within agreed timelines.
* Define service levels and performance measures for issuers, service teams and internal stakeholders, and lead regular governance reviews.
* Identify opportunities to increase compliant P\-Card usage, reduce low\-value purchase\-order and invoice volumes, and improve the employee and supplier experience.
* Deliver measurable benefits through process simplification, automation, improved visibility, reduced processing effort and stronger spend control.
* Plan resources and manage implementation capacity, budget and third\-party costs within approved parameters.
* Lead and develop the implementation team, promoting accountability, collaboration, continuous learning and strong risk ownership.
* Embed a sustainable business\-as\-usual model, including ownership, support arrangements, control monitoring, change management and continuous improvement.
* Embed resilience, access, data protection, fraud prevention and contingency controls in the programme design.


**Skills And Experience**
**Must\-have Skills**
* Advanced Accounts Payables Knowledge (E2E)
* Payment Operations \& Controls
* Financial Accounting \& Reconciliation
* Operational Risk Management
* Regulatory Compliance \& Governance
* Data Analytics \& Business Reporting
* Strategic Operations Management
* Stakeholder Management \& Influencing
* Change \& Transformation Leadership
* Process Excellence \& Continuous Improvement
* People Leadership \& Talent Development
* Resource and Capacity Planning


**Other Skills**
* AI and Automation Technologies
* ERP and Workflow Management Solutions
* SAP (VIM / S4 HANA / Ariba)


**Qualifications**
**Key Experiences:**
* 12\+ years of experience in Procure\-to\-Pay, Accounts Payable, Purchasing Cards, Corporate Cards, expense management, procurement operations or payment operations.
* Proven experience leading a multi\-market P\-Card or Corporate Card implementation, expansion or major transformation from design through stabilisation.
* Strong knowledge of the card lifecycle, issuer operations, expense management, settlement, reconciliation, accounting and exception handling.
* Demonstrated experience designing and operating P\-Card governance, policies, transaction controls, approval limits, segregation of duties, fraud prevention and audit trails.
* Experience integrating card issuers and expense platforms with procurement, enterprise resource planning and finance systems, including testing and cutover management.
* Proven programme leadership across Finance, Procurement, Treasury, Tax, Technology, Information Security, Risk, Compliance, Legal and external service providers.
* Experience managing senior stakeholders, governance forums, vendors, risks, issues, budgets, benefits and implementation reporting in a complex global organisation.


**Certifications / Qualifications (only Where Mandatory)**
* Bachelor's Degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* MBA, CA, CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent qualification preferred.
* Certifications in Risk Management, Operational Excellence, Project Management, or Finance Transformation desirable.


**Language**
* English


**Motivations**
* Strategic Leadership
* Operational Excellence
* Continuous Improvement
* Innovation \& Transformation
* Customer Centricity
* Risk \& Control Management
* Talent Development
* Accountability
* Influencing \& Collaboration
* Problem Solving and Decision Making


**About Standard Chartered**
 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
   

  

 Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
   

  

**Together We**
* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term


**What We Offer**

 Human Capital team helps Deloitte client service teams support value creation through people's performance.  As an experienced Manager, you will oversee the delivery of enterprise\-scale change management solutions, lead cross\-functional teams, drive client conversations, and mentor junior practitioners. You will collaborate to understand overarching change requirements, support sales and proposal efforts, and drive end\-to\-end change management delivery, including resource estimations and strategic planning, to ensure successful outcomes.

 Across our service offerings, you will:

* Fine tune your capabilities and build a sustainable leadership franchise that you can execute against in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Network and train others in the firm, help others group through development and delivery of knowledge sharing


 As an experienced OCM Manager, you will:
   

  

* Serve as a senior trusted advisor to client executives and project leadership, bringing deep OCM expertise, industry perspective, and leading practices to shape transformation strategies, challenge assumptions, guide key decisions, and translate complex organizational challenges into pragmatic, outcome\-oriented solutions. Anticipate cross\-workstream implications, risks, and adoption barriers, and align stakeholders around effective mitigation strategies.
* Design and execute change management strategy/programs and associated activities for large\-scale transformation projects including, but not limited to, stakeholder engagement, change assessment, training strategy and development, communications plan, organization design and governance, and culture solutions that enable industry\-leading clients to meet and exceed their digitalization goals.
* Outline and guide design of change strategy components, including organization architecture, go\-to\-market journey, deployment approach, and end\-user onboarding experience.
* Manage resource allocation on projects and their utilization during the entire change management lifecycle.
* Design tailored organizational change architectures that address complex transformational requirements.
* Champion the responsible use of generative AI, automation, and digital tools to improve delivery efficiency, accelerate analysis, and enhance the quality and scalability of client solutions.
* Regularly track status of change management project plan deliverables to ensure alignment with organizational timelines/objectives, and report out to senior client/project leadership.
* Lead/manage one or more teams responsible for developing and deploying change programs for technical implementations, digitalization and emerging technology initiatives.
* Liaise with leads from other workstreams and subject matter experts (SMEs).
* Perform quality assurance across project deliverables to ensure they meet Deloitte and client quality standards.
* Regularly manage, mentor, and evaluate team of junior practitioners to support their career progression.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior client/project leadership, anticipate project risks/watch items and propose mitigation strategies to client teams, to remove roadblocks for the development team.
* Lead and manage business development efforts, including Statements of Work (SOW), proposal development/sales pursuits, client presentations, etc.
* Lead and contribute to practice developmental growth and innovation through initiatives including culture building, internal community involvement, eminence, recruiting, whitepapers, etc.

 Our Human Capital team helps Deloitte client service teams support value creation through people's performance. We guide teams in reimagining work, the workforce, and the workplace across the enterprise, and help in transforming HR functions with AI and emerging technology. With the rapid pace of change in today's world, you will help provide insights and enable delivery to address questions such as: How do organizations access, develop, and motivate their workforce? What should the AI strategy be for the HR function? Do they have the right organization and culture to enable performance? Join our team to help make work better for humans and humans better at work.
   

  

 The Organization Workforce \& Change practice focuses on transforming the organization to support its business strategy. This involves helping our clients move from where they are today to where they need to be in the future. This could include changing the organization’s culture, modernizing specific functions, and redesigning the organization structure. It will require a combination of change management actions to execute the transformation. To enable our success, it will be critical to use data and insights to inform better ways of working together.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

 Required:

title: Assistant / Deputy Manager – OFR Export Operations
description:
**About Ocean Freight Operations**
 The Ocean Freight Operations team plays a pivotal role in managing all ocean\-bound imports and exports, utilizing a diverse range of equipment and services. The team collaborates closely with a network of ocean carriers, Procurement \& capacity management (PCM), and participating in major carrier alliances to secure planned space protection from key container ports globally. This meticulous coordination is essential for ensuring a reliable and efficient transportation process for ocean\-bound cargo.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As an integral part of Ocean Freight Export Operations/ Documentation, an incumbent role in ensuring the efficiency of Export processes within the specified region. The role of OFR (Ocean Freight Operations) involves supporting the intricacies of ocean\-bound cargo movements. It involves coordinating with various processes, including vessel scheduling, cargo documentation, interaction with ocean carriers to constantly strive for optimizing efficiency, regulations, and maintaining high standards of service.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Operational Excellence:**
* Ensure cost\-effective and high\-quality export ocean freight operations.
* Assist in procuring and managing cargo capacity efficiently, overseeing all port operations.
* Ensure operational compliance and error\-free documentation.
* Responsible for the smooth execution of export shipments, adhering to customer requirements, country regulations, and customs trade practices.
* Ensure regulatory compliance related to AMS, ACI, ISF, and FMC filing.
* Implement CW1 Best Practices, including auto rating, auto costing, timely and accurate cost estimation, billing, ESI \& E\-Booking, milestone updating, and file closure.
* Achieve set operational performance targets.
* Proactively address and manage operational irregularities.
* Efficiently handle customer complaints and plug potential revenue leakages.
* Avoid claims and penalties due to service failures.
* Adhere to agreed SOP/COP for releasing documents to customers (Cash/Credit).
* Manage the vendor payment process and shipment tracking.
* Coordinate with Gateway Operation Team for CFS stuffing containers \& consol.
* Collaborate with PCM team for carrier rates filing.
* Taking complete responsibility for independently managing customer accounts, guided by both supervisor and manager, following the 'one file, one operator' approach.
* Drive the implementation of sustainable environmental practices within the ocean freight operations, contributing to corporate social responsibility goals.


**Stakeholder Management**
* Enhance customer satisfaction by delivering exceptional services.
* Manage relationships with carriers, suppliers, and the network.
* Interface with the sales team and customer service team.


**Customer \& Network Support:**
* Enhance customer satisfaction through best\-in\-class services.
* Record complaints concerning all export shipments.
* Address and resolve network\-related issues.
* Maintain regular communication with sales and support teams.


**COMPETENCIES**
**Functional Competencies**
* Product Knowledge: Thorough knowledge of products, services, and logistics industry.
* Customer Service: Strong customer service skills to address inquiries, provide updates, and resolve issues related to shipments.
* Technology Proficiency: Implementing CW1 and other tools for optimizing operations.
* Customs Regulations Acumen: Understanding of customs procedures, tariff and international trade laws for industry regulations and standards.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Agility: Ability to adapt quickly to changing operational needs and environments.
* Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and improve skills to enhance performance.
* Attention to Detail: Consistently maintaining accuracy and precision in tasks and documentation.
* Quality Orientation: Commitment to delivering high\-quality results and services.
* Initiative: Taking proactive steps to improve processes or address issues without waiting for direction.
* Team Collaboration: Collaborating across teams for smooth operations.


**WHO CAN APPLY?**
**Must Have**
* 2\-3 years of experience in the shipping/logistics industry for Executive/Sr. Exec.
* 4\-5 years of experience in the shipping/logistics industry for AM/DM
* Bachelor’s degree in any field.
* Proven experience in running smooth operations processes.
* Basic problem\-solving skills to address common challenges.
* Proficient in Email writing and verbal communication with internal and external coordination.


**Preferred**
* Courses and certifications in business administration, operations management.
* Completed Cargo Basic and Dangerous Goods courses.


**Qualified freshers are welcome.**

title: Regional Manager Operations - Chennai
description:
Sharief Bhai is looking for a Regional Manager to own store\-level P\&L, operations, and people leadership across our Tier\-2 South cluster — including Coimbatore, Palakkad, Manipal, and surrounding markets. This role is central to Sharief Bhai's push to become a Top\-3 brand in its core markets, and offers direct ownership over revenue, cost, quality, and team performance for 6–10 stores.
 



  
 



**Role Overview** 




  
 



 The Regional Manager will be the single point of accountability for a cluster of 6–10 Sharief Bhai stores in Tier\-2 South cities. This is a high\-ownership, on\-ground role combining P\&L management, store operations, people leadership, and quality/compliance oversight. The role reports to the GM – Operations and requires frequent travel across the assigned cluster.
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




  
 



**P\&L \& Revenue (Primary Focus)** 




 ·        Own store\-level P\&L across the assigned cluster — revenue, food cost, labour cost, and controllable expenses
 



 ·        Drive top\-line growth through online (aggregator) and offline/dine\-in channels; track AOV, order volume, and discounting
 



 ·        Monitor cost levers (food cost %, wastage, utilities, manpower cost) and drive corrective action on deviations
 



 ·        Deliver monthly business reviews with clear performance narratives and action plans for underperforming stores
 



  
 



**Team Management** 




  
 



 Manage and develop a team of Restaurant Managers, and front\-of\-house (FOH) and back\-of\-house (BOH) staff
 



 Drive hiring, training, and performance management across the cluster in line with company SOPs
 



 Build a strong bench of Restaurant Managers and reduce frontline attrition
 



  
 



**Store Operations, Maintenance \& Quality** 




  
 



 Ensure stores are audit\-ready at all times; own corrective action plans for quality/food\-safety audit scores
 



 Coordinate store maintenance (equipment, infrastructure, licensing) with central maintenance and procurement teams
 



 Ensure consistent adherence to SOPs across hygiene, service, and product quality
 



 Travel \& On\-Ground Presence
 



 Conduct regular store visits across the cluster (Coimbatore, Palakkad, Manipal, and other Tier\-2 South markets)
 



 Represent store\-level ground realities in reviews with central ops, QA, and procurement teams
 



  
 



**What We're Looking For** 




  
 



 5–8 years of experience in restaurant/QSR/retail operations, including 2\+ years managing multiple units or teams
 



 Strong P\&L orientation — comfortable owning revenue and cost numbers, not just operational metrics
 



 Proven people\-management experience across store\-level teams (Restaurant Managers, FOH, BOH)
 



 Willingness and ability to travel frequently within the assigned region
 



 Working knowledge of food safety/quality audit processes and store maintenance coordination
 



 Data\-driven approach — comfortable reading store dashboards, audit reports, and P\&L statements
 



 Fluency in English and working proficiency in regional languages relevant to the cluster (Tamil/Malayalam/Kannada) preferred
 








**Success Metrics** 









 Store\-level revenue growth and cost (food \& labour) as % of revenue vs. target
 



 Quality/food\-safety audit scores across cluster stores (target: consistently above 80%)
 



 Team attrition and Restaurant Manager bench strength
 



 Store uptime/serviceability and resolution TAT on maintenance issues

description:
****Role Overview****
 The Senior Tunnel Manager (STM) is responsible for the
 **day?to?day management, coordination, and technical oversight of tunneling works**

 **key operational and technical link**

 **EPB TBM operations in mixed geology and hard?rock conditions** 
 , ensuring safety, quality, productivity, and adherence to approved methodologies and schedules.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
****Operational \& Technical Management****
* Plan, coordinate, and supervise tunneling activities across multiple shifts, including TBM excavation, segment erection, backup works, and tunnel services.
* Ensure EPB TBM operations are carried out as per approved method statements, design requirements, and safety standards.
* Monitor TBM performance, advance rates, consumptions, downtime, and key production indicators.
* Provide technical guidance to Tunnel Shift Managers (TSM) and TBM teams for resolving operational and geological challenges.


****Geotechnical \& Risk Management****
* Review ground conditions, TBM behavior, and instrumentation data; identify emerging risks and implement mitigation measures.
* Coordinate with design, geotechnical, and monitoring teams to ensure ground control and tunnel stability.
* Support planning and execution of special operations such as cutter interventions, ground treatment, and recovery works.


****Safety \& Quality Assurance****
* Ensure strict implementation of underground safety procedures and permit?to?work systems.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with safety standards across all shifts.
* Monitor quality of segment installation, ring geometry, grouting, and tunnel finishing works.


****Coordination \& Reporting****
* Coordinate with maintenance, electrical, ventilation, logistics, and survey teams to ensure uninterrupted tunneling progress.
* Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly tunneling reports covering progress, safety, quality, and risks.
* Report key issues, risks, and performance trends to the Chief Tunnel Manager (CTM).


****Team Leadership****
* Lead, mentor, and develop Tunnel Shift Managers (TSM) and engineering teams.
* Ensure effective communication and coordination between shifts and departments.

* Strong hands?on experience in EPB TBM tunneling, preferably for metro or urban underground projects.
* Good understanding of mixed?ground and hard?rock tunneling behavior.
* Ability to manage multiple shifts and coordinate large tunnel crews.
* Strong knowledge of underground safety systems, risk management, and quality control.
* Effective leadership, communication, and problem?solving skills.

title: Area Commercial Manager - Tamil Nadu and Kerala
description:
**Mission** 




 Across many parts of India, patients still face significant barriers to accessing innovative therapies, particularly in specialty and rare disease areas. Awareness gaps, fragmented healthcare infrastructure, and affordability challenges often delay access to treatments that could significantly improve outcomes.
 



 At FarmaMondo, our mission is to close this gap by bringing innovative specialty medicines to markets where they are needed most. As we continue to expand in India, we are looking for an entrepreneurial
 **Area Commercial Manager – Tamil Nadu and Kerala** 
 who can help build our presence from the ground up, drive commercial growth, and establish strong partnerships with healthcare stakeholders across the region.
 



  





**About FarmaMondo** 




 FarmaMondo is a fast\-growing Swiss pharmaceutical group focused on improving access to specialty medicines in emerging markets.
 



 Through our unique model combining market access expertise with commercialization capabilities, we work to ensure that both licensed and unlicensed therapies reach patients in countries where treatment options are limited.
 



 India is a key strategic market for our growth, and South India represents an important hub for specialty healthcare institutions and centers of excellence.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The
 **Area Commercial Manager –** 
 Tamilnadu and Kerala will be responsible for building and expanding FarmaMondo’s commercial footprint across the region covering states of
 **Tamil Nadu and Kerala.** 
 Based in
 **Chennai** 
 , this role will lead regional Access strategy, develop key hospital partnerships, manage communication with patients \& care givers and facilitate access of FarmaMondo’s specialty portfolio.
 



 This is a hands\-on, high\-impact role within innovative MNC environment, ideal for someone who thrives in a fast\-growing environment and enjoys building new markets, creating opportunities, and shaping strategy on the ground.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




  





*Drive Regional Growth* 



* Implement the commercial Access strategy for South India, identifying opportunities to expand FarmaMondo’s specialty portfolio.
* Deliver strong patient access objectives through focused engagement with key hospitals and specialty centers.
* Ensure consistent execution of commercial plans and field activities.



  





*Build Strategic Relationships* 



* Establish trusted partnerships with KOLs, hospital administrators, procurement teams, and specialty physicians.
* Strengthen FarmaMondo’s presence in leading hospitals and centers of excellence across South India.
* Support scientific and commercial engagement initiatives that increase awareness of innovative therapies.



  





*Identify New Opportunities* 



* Analyze market dynamics and patient flows, funding options for access
* Provide insights from the field to support India strategy, market access initiatives, and future portfolio expansion.



  





*Collaborate Across the Organization* 



* Work closely with Market Access, Medical Affairs, and Supply Chain teams to ensure product availability and successful commercialization.
* Contribute regional insights that help shape FarmaMondo’s India growth strategy.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Around 10 years of specialty pharmaceutical commercial experience in the territory in MNC
* Strong understanding of hospital\-based and specialty medicine markets.
* Proven ability to build markets, grow accounts, and lead teams in dynamic environments.
* Experience engaging with KOLs and major hospital networks.
* Therapeutic area exposure in oncology is required



  





**Who You Are** 



* Entrepreneurial and comfortable building things from the ground up.
* A strong relationship builder with credibility in the healthcare community.
* Commercially driven with a strategic mindset.
* Passionate about improving patient access to innovative therapies.
* Taking complete accountability of our performance in the region

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Join Deloitte Cyber to help clients identify, assess, and reduce exposure across their digital environment. As a Manager, you will lead vulnerability management and attack surface management efforts by driving program execution, improving visibility into asset risk, and helping stakeholders prioritize remediation actions. You will work with global teams, enterprise security tools, and reporting frameworks to strengthen cyber situational awareness and support resilient operations.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Manager on the Cyber Defense \& Resilience team, you will be responsible for…
   

  

* Lead the design, implementation, and day\-to\-day management of vulnerability management activities across client environments
* Develop and maintain policies, standards, procedures, and reporting processes for vulnerability assessment, prioritization, and remediation
* Oversee scanning, testing, and analysis activities using enterprise tools to identify vulnerabilities, rogue assets, and exposure trends
* Communicate risk posture, remediation progress, and key metrics to technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership

**The team**

By continuously monitoring client environments—networks, applications, cloud assets, and endpoints—they proactively uncover potential exposure points before threat actors can exploit them. Attack Surface Management (ASM) is a foundational capability within the Cyber Defense \& Resilience portfolio, enabling proactive identification and mitigation of security vulnerabilities across an organization’s digital landscape.

title: Transformation Lead - AD
description:
**Role:** 
 Transformation Lead
   

  

**Business Vertical:** 
 IOA – Tech
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Hands\-on leader who acts as one of our most senior technical experts in the field. This is a unique, dual\-mission role. Externally, you will engage with our most strategic clients in a "forward\-deployed" capacity, leading technical workshops to design and integrate our data solutions into their complex ecosystems. Internally, you will use these client insights to architect and build the next generation of AI\-powered tools and workflows, radically optimizing our own data annotation processes. Your ultimate goal is to create an unbeatable competitive advantage by continuously improving our efficiency, quality, and delivery, directly reducing our clients' Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Client Solution Engineering \& Integration (External Focus)**
* Lead Technical Discovery \& Solution Design: Post\-sale, partner with the Solutioning team to lead deep\-dive technical workshops with clients. Deconstruct their current workflows, data challenges, and business objectives.
* Architect Custom Integration Plans: Design and map out how our platform and services will integrate seamlessly into the client's existing AI/ML pipelines and infrastructure.
* Act as the "Art of the Possible" Guide: Serve as the primary technical advisor to clients, demonstrating how our advanced capabilities, custom tools, and innovative workflows can solve their most difficult data challenges and accelerate their AI initiatives.
* Bridge to the Platform Team: Translate complex client requirements into precise technical specifications and user stories for our core Platform Deployment \& Management team, ensuring our platform roadmap is directly informed by real\-world client needs.
* Oversee Proofs of Concept (POCs): Lead and develop targeted POCs to prove the value and viability of our solutions within the client's environment, de\-risking large\-scale engagements.


**Internal Process Transformation \& Innovation (Internal Focus)**
* Drive Process Excellence: Be the owner of operational efficiency for our data annotation workforce. Continuously analyze our Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) workflows to identify and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Develop AI\-Powered "Co\-Pilots" and Accelerators: Architect, build, and deploy a portfolio of internal tools and intelligent agents that augment our human annotators. This includes automated quality checks, predictive assistance, and workflow\-agnostic automation scripts.
* Engineer "Safety Nets": Design and implement automated quality assurance (QA) systems and predictive monitoring to ensure we consistently exceed client SLAs for accuracy and throughput.
* Champion Human\-in\-the\-Loop Optimization: Leverage Generative AI, LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), and computer vision models to create systems that make our human workforce smarter, faster, and more accurate.
* Quantify Business Impact: Develop and maintain a framework to measure the ROI of your transformation initiatives, clearly demonstrating their impact on project margins, delivery speed, and client TCO.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* Experience: 14\+ years in a technology field, with at least 5 years in a senior, client\-facing technical role such as a Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, Professional Services Consultant, or Transformation Lead.
* Applied AI \& Process Automation: Proven, hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-grade AI/ML systems specifically for process automation and optimization. This is more important than pure research experience.
* Generative AI Stack Expertise: Deep, practical experience with the modern Generative AI stack, including LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), agentic frameworks, and vector databases. You must have built things with these technologies.
* Hybrid Skillset: A demonstrated ability to operate at the intersection of deep technology and business strategy. You must be able to write code and architect systems, but also create a compelling business case and present to a client executive.
* Cloud Architecture: Deep architectural expertise in one or more major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including their managed AI/ML services (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Consultative Mindset: A natural ability to listen, diagnose problems, and guide clients and internal teams toward elegant, effective solutions.
* Data Annotation Domain Knowledge: Direct experience with data annotation platforms, data quality challenges, and the operational dynamics of large\-scale data labeling workforces.
* Experience Building Internal Tools: A track record of identifying an internal business need and building a software solution to address it, driving measurable efficiency gains.
* An advanced degree (master's or PhD) in Computer Science, AI, or a related field is a strong plus.
* A portfolio of projects (e.g., GitHub) or detailed case studies demonstrating your work in building AI\-driven solutions.

 At Presidio, we’re at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting\-edge digital solutions and next\-generation AI. We empower businesses—and their customers—to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.
   

  

**The Role**
**Strategic Ownership \& Leadership**
* Own and manage the cloud ecosystem across AWS, Azure, and GCP, ensuring they operate with high efficiency, strong governance, and predictable costs.
* Lead a small team of cloud engineers, guiding and coaching them in roadmap creation, prioritization, execution, and skills development.
* Act as a strategic advisor to engineering, architecture, and business stakeholders on sandbox governance, usage patterns, and optimization strategies.
* Establish and enforce policies for onboarding, offboarding, resource lifecycle, and access management for users.


**Operational Excellence \& Automation**
* Design and implement automation for sandbox provisioning, quota management, access approval workflows, scheduling, and spin\-up/spin\-down processes.
* Develop and maintain reusable automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Python, Cloud\-native tools) for repeatable lab operations.\[MS1]
* Create self\-service capabilities and guardrails for sandbox users to reduce manual effort and improve governance.
* Collaborate on lab, demo, and proof of concept engagements with internal and external stakeholders.


**FinOps, Cost Governance \& Optimization**
* Implement a FinOps\-aligned operating model for all accounts including tagging standards, cost allocation, budget enforcement, and showback/chargeback across all clouds.
* Continuously analyze cloud spend trends, forecast usage, and proactively identify opportunities for rightsizing, decommissioning, and efficiency improvements.
* Build automation for policy\-based cleanup of unused/idle resources.


**Security, Governance \& Compliance**
* Define and implement security guardrails, baseline configurations, identity/access rules, and monitoring policies for sandbox environments.
* Ensure compliance with organizational governance controls and enforce boundaries between sandbox and production environments.
* Implement monitoring dashboards, alerts, and operational metrics to ensure visibility and control.


**Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**
* Proactively introduce new approaches, tools, and technologies to make lab and demo operations more efficient, secure, and cost\-effective.
* Conduct periodic reviews of account usage patterns to identify opportunities for consolidation, automation, or architectural improvements.
* Partner with cloud providers, vendors, and internal teams to evaluate new services and establish best practices.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, or cloud operations roles, with at least 3 years in a technical leadership or team lead position.
* Strong hands\-on expertise with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and working knowledge of the other two.
* Demonstrated experience in managing large or multi\-tenant cloud environments, including governance, account/projects/subscription management.
* Strong automation experience using Terraform, CloudFormation, Python, PowerShell, Ansible, or similar tools.
* Understanding of Cloud Networking Concepts, such as AWS VPCs, Transit Gateways, Azure VNets, Public DNS with AWS Route 53 and VPN tunnel creation from the hyperscaler side.
* Familiarity with Cloud Compute and Storage such as EC2 Instances, Azure Virtual Machines, Google Compute Engine, AWS S3/EBS/EFS and/or Azure Disk Storage
* Proven expertise in FinOps, cloud cost governance, and optimization frameworks.
* Strong understanding of cloud security, IAM, guardrails, monitoring, and policy management.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and mentoring skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Professional certifications: AWS Solutions Architect / Azure Architect Expert / GCP Professional Cloud Architect.
* Prior experience in managing demo or lab environments, platform engineering, or multi\-cloud landing zones.
* Experience with cost analytics tools (CloudHealth, Flexera, Cloud Custodian, Kubecost, native cost tools).
* Knowledge of container platforms (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD workflows.
* Exposure to Cloud Centers of Excellence (CCoE) or platform engineering teams.


**Your future at Presidio**
 Joining Presidio means stepping into a culture of trailblazers—thinkers, builders, and collaborators—who push the boundaries of what’s possible. With our expertise in AI\-driven analytics, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, and next\-gen infrastructure, we enable businesses to stay ahead in an ever\-evolving digital world.
   

  

 Here, your impact is real. Whether you're harnessing the power of Generative AI, architecting resilient digital ecosystems, or driving data\-driven transformation, you’ll be part of a team that is shaping the future.
   

  

**Ready to innovate? Let’s redefine what’s next—together.**
**About Presidio**
 At Presidio, speed and quality meet technology and innovation. Presidio is a trusted ally for organizations across industries with a decades\-long history of building traditional IT foundations and deep expertise in AI and automation, security, networking, digital transformation, and cloud computing. Presidio fills gaps, removes hurdles, optimizes costs, and reduces risk. Presidio’s expert technical team develops custom applications, provides managed services, enables actionable data insights and builds forward\-thinking solutions that drive strategic outcomes for clients globally.
 **For more information, visit www.presidio.com** 
**.**
 Presidio is committed to hiring the most qualified candidates to join our amazing culture. We aim to attract and hire top talent from all backgrounds, including underrepresented and marginalized communities. We encourage women, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans to apply for open roles at Presidio. Diversity of skills and thought is a key component to our business success.
   

  

***Recruitment Agencies, Please Note:***
 Presidio does not accept unsolicited agency resumes/CVs. Do not forward resumes/CVs to our careers email address, Presidio employees or any other means. Presidio is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/CVs.

title: Manager Industrial System Analytic GDI&A
description:

Successful candidates will provide technical and thought leadership in advanced analytics, AI/ML, and people management.
