Given the dynamic nature of data analytics and AI, a commitment to continuous learning and upskilling and being hands\-on is essential. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, hands\-on experience, strategic thinking, and strong leadership skills.
   

  

 As a Data Science Manager, you will
   

  

* lead a multi\-disciplinary team of data scientists, machine learning engineers, product designers, data engineers, and software engineers through the entire lifecycle of complex analytical and AI/ML projects.
* provide technical leadership and be hands\-on from concept to deployment.
* collaborate across GDI\&A functions and partner with business stakeholders to drive strategic outcomes.
* lead, mentor, and inspire your team to deliver impactful results, while fostering an innovative, collaborative, and high\-performing environment.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Strategic \& Technical Leadership: Lead business engagement, apply and refine methodologies to deliver analytical solutions that help data driven decision making to reduce cost, improve quality and deliver value across Ford Enterprise.
* Data Improvement \& Integration: Collaborate with business partners, GDI\&A functional teams and Centers of Excellence to improve data quality and integrate data from diverse sources.
* Hands\-on Expertise: Build, improve, and deploy Machine Learning \& AI models to provide descriptive, predictive and prescriptive analytics.
* Team Leadership \& Mentorship: Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing team, fostering best practices in software development and data science.
* Technology Strategy: Develop and implement a roadmap for adopting and integrating new technologies (e.g., GCP).


**Cross\-functional Collaboration:** 
 Work effectively with various teams and stakeholders to achieve business objectives
   

  

**Required**
* Master's degree (PhD preferred) in Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience applying supervised and unsupervised machine learning and AI/ML techniques field (OEM experience preferred).
* 5\+ years of leading a team of cross\-functional technical experts.
* Proficiency in R and Python, along with experience with ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit\-Learn, XGBoost).
* Experience with GCP and data related technologies (SQL, Spark, Hive).
* Strong technical \& people leadership, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Experience working with Agile methodologies.
* Strong experience with Java/AngularJS/ReactJS.


**Preferred**
* Experience with NLP, deep learning, neural network architectures, computer vision, reliability, survival analysis and anomaly detection techniques.
* Familiarity with computationally intensive statistical methods, Software development life cycle, Agile, Jira, system architecture principles, PDO processes and software craftmanship.
* Google Digital Leader certification.

title: Site Manager/ Cadd/ Jr Architect
description:
**Company Description** 
 ACE GFRC \& FRP Private Limited is dedicated to creating architectural landmarks that combine strength, elegance, and innovation. Specializing in Glass Fiber Reinforced Concrete (GFRC) and Fiber Reinforced Plastic (FRP), the company offers durable and visually striking solutions for contemporary architecture. Its portfolio ranges from intricate facades and sculptures to customized architectural elements, all crafted with precision and engineering excellence. ACE GFRC \& FRP collaborates closely with architects, builders, and developers to turn visionary concepts into sustainable, long\-lasting structures that inspire generations.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Chennai for a Site Manager / CAD / Junior Architect professional. The role involves overseeing site execution for GFRC and FRP installations, coordinating with project stakeholders, and ensuring work aligns with design specifications, timelines, and quality standards. Day\-to\-day tasks include reviewing drawings, preparing detailed CAD plans, assisting in design development, and providing technical support to site teams. The position also requires tracking project progress, supervising contractors, ensuring adherence to safety and compliance requirements, and reporting issues or risks to senior management. The successful candidate will collaborate with design, production, and client teams to deliver projects that reflect the company’s commitment to excellence in architecture.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit) and ability to prepare detailed architectural and fabrication drawings.
* Experience in site management, including supervision of installation works, coordination with contractors, and quality control.
* Understanding of architectural design principles, building materials, and construction methodologies, preferably with exposure to GFRC/FRP or façade systems.
* Strong project coordination skills, including scheduling, documentation, and communication with cross\-functional teams and clients.
* Knowledge of safety standards, regulatory requirements, and best practices for on\-site construction activities.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Architecture, Civil Engineering, or a related field.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural and structural drawings accurately.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Prior experience in architectural fabrication, façades, or similar project\-based environments is an advantage.
* Willingness to work on\-site in Chennai and visit project locations as required.

description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Role Name And Description**
 Manager, AXIS Modeling, Life Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting
   

  

* Lead a diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team
* Be part of a high\-performing, supportive culture
* Work with a team of collaborators, innovators and the brightest minds in the industry


 Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high\-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!

* We are looking for a Manager to join our Life Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering AXIS modeling solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
* You can expect to work along with senior managers/directors to support large scale engagements and deliver high\-quality client solutions. You will develop and maintain long\-term relationships and networks, build and energize a high performing team.
* Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.

 As a Manager within the Actuarial AXIS modelling team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
   

  

**On engagements, you will:**
* Responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Demonstrate the ability to apply their problem\-solving skills to new and complex situations and problems with minimal supervision and maintain quality and accuracy
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff/Senior members

* Overall 8\+ to 15 years of actuarial experience with 6\+ years of AXIS modeling experience or in AXIS valuation / reporting / pricing experience in life actuarial team of an insurance / consulting / outsourcing company
* Good understanding of US/ Canada product lines and regulations; hands\-on IFRS17 or LDTI implementation experience (optional)
* Project management experience and ability to handle teams and multiple stakeholders
* Advance modelling experience in AXIS software
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* Strong presentation and documentation skills
* We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging, and supporting our global network.

 Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organisations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

* Qualified or Part/ nearly Qualified Actuary with at least 8\+ years to 15 years of experience in Life Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, IFRS17 or LDTI)
* Ability to multi\-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a moderate sized team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS\-Office Suite, Power BI, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, SPSS, etc., will be a plus

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Ability to review work done by junior members, ensuring quality of work product during time sensitive deadlines
* The ability to build relationships with colleagues across the business, support them and promote a collaborative environment
* Overseas exposure (especially US/Canada/Europe/UK/Australia market experience)

title: AI Transformation Lead

 Havas Life Mumbai

 At Havas Life Mumbai, we believe meaningful ideas have the power to improve lives. As part of the global Havas Health Network, we partner with leading pharmaceutical, healthcare, wellness, and consumer health brands to create award\-winning campaigns that educate, inspire, and drive real impact. From brand strategy and integrated campaigns to digital experiences, content, and medical communications, our work combines creativity with science to solve complex healthcare challenges.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We are looking for an
 **AI Lead** 
 who can drive the next phase of
 **AI\-led transformation**

 This role is about identifying how AI can fundamentally improve the way we work from
 **process redesign and automation to productivity, cost optimisation and smarter program management** 
 . You will work across functions to identify opportunities, evaluate emerging AI solutions and take initiatives from idea to implementation and measurable business impact – by aligning to the global Havas vision and mission and AI Transformation framework.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Identify operational and process inefficiencies across functions and develop AI\-led solutions to improve productivity, quality, speed and scalability.
* Lead AI transformation programs end\-to\-end from opportunity identification and business case development to implementation, adoption and impact measurement.
* Evaluate and experiment with Generative AI, AI agents, automation platforms, LLM\-based tools and emerging AI technologies to identify practical business applications.
* Liaise with Global AI teams and implement mandates to local.
* Partner with Creative, Strategy, Medical, Client Servicing, Operations, HR, Finance and other teams to redesign workflows and implement AI\-enabled processes.
* Identify opportunities for automation, resource optimisation and cost reduction, and build measurable ROI cases for transformation initiatives.
* Manage multiple cross\-functional programs, including timelines, stakeholders, dependencies, milestones, and success metrics.
* Establish scalable AI\-enabled workflows, frameworks, and operating models that can be adopted across teams.
* Track and communicate productivity gains, cost efficiencies, adoption and business impact of AI initiatives to leadership.
* Drive AI adoption and change management through workshops, training, and continuous enablement.
* Stay ahead of the rapidly evolving AI landscape, identifying tools and technologies that can create meaningful competitive and operational advantages for the organisation.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 4–8 years of experience in AI transformation, digital/business transformation, automation, consulting, operations excellence, program management, innovation, or related roles.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, workflow automation and emerging AI tools/platforms.
* Proven ability to translate business problems into practical technology and AI solutions.
* Strong program management and stakeholder management skills, with experience driving cross\-functional initiatives.
* Commercial mindset with the ability to identify and quantify productivity, efficiency, and cost\-saving opportunities.

description:

**Your Mission, Roles And Responsibilities**
**Overall responsibilities and duties:**
**Responsibilities**
 The Buyer is responsible to develop and manage the supplier panel for a specific commodity segment, selecting suppliers according to Faurecia group criteria, apply purchasing policy, and develop suppliers to continuously improve QCD performance. The Buyer identifies and leads ideas and initiatives in order to improve the global productivity and achieve or surpass financial objectives. Additional responsibilities of the buyer are:
   

  

* Improve financial performance of the Division through supplier negotiations, resourcing and productivity actions
* Monitor supplier Quality, Cost and Delivery performance and challenge supplier when supplier is falling short of targets


**The Main Responsibilities Of The Role Are**
* Develop and execute segment Commodity Strategy;
* Define and lead activities aligned to Commodity Strategy
* Responsible for delivering purchasing budget, updating forecast, reporting monthly savings
* Support Program Buyers with sourcing of new segments and supplier Panel definition
* Pursue optimally economical costs for goods/services required, in conjunction with obtaining continual long term agreement savings opportunities
* Performs continual review and evaluation of the current supply base and also new potential suppliers through cross\-functional supplier audits/visits based on the criteria provided by Group
* Facilitate continuous improvement activities with the supply base to support VA/VE savings opportunities
* ECR/EO activity – obtain quotes for engineering changes, understand and challenge supply base assumptions
* Lead supplier VA/VE activity and participate in lean manufacturing workshops
* Progress savings from inception through to implementation
* Conduct management meetings to review and improve supplier performance
* Manage and understand supplier´s tool life and monitor/secure capacity
* Other duties and specific projects as identified to support commercial targets and supplier optimization ▪ Identify savings, update forecast file and follow through to completion. Take ownership and responsibility for actions under buyer, lead activity
* Identify savings at month end and cross\-reference against productivity file to confirm completion.
* Report savings each month to Manager and confirm with Controller that they are captured.
* Charge Back validation costs via QSS database for poor quality and delivery performance.
* Follow supplier debits from forecast to debit memo to receipt of cash
* Calculate retroactive debits/credits for late identified savings, ensure they are captured at month end, follow through to cash receipt or debit execution.
* Hold monthly supplier management reviews to identify savings gaps, get up to speed on quality issues, communicate FAS intentions, understand supplier glide path to target etc.
* Interface between department and plant or Commercial Business Unit.
* Issue PO for approval for changes required/authorized
* In event of supplier disruption to plant (quality or delivery), understand root cause/scope of issue and facilitate supplier interaction to help resolve issue
* Monitors of the Supplier Global Performance Measurement in terms of quality and service of the cost via the SBG reporting structures
* Follows market trends for specific commodities and raw materials
* Prepares and deploys Commodity Strategies \& Cost Models for various commodities
* Understand all cost break\-downs and challenge supply base accordingly to ensure cost is optimized
* Have the ability to fully understand cost models and be able to provide input towards generating a cost model


**Your profile and competencies to succeed**

 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering or related field.
   

  

**Experience**
* 12 years in automotive industry
* 12 years in purchasing functions
* SAP experience (preferred)


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Must have very good Excel and Word skills
* Strong communication skills
* Able to accommodate \~15% \- 20% travel (domestic \& international)
* Commitment to the highest ethical standards and willingness to adhere to Faurecia’s Code of Ethics and Code of Management
* Team Player

* We are the seventh\-largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in more than 40 countries which makes a lot of opportunity for career development.
* We welcome energetic and agile people who can thrive in a fast\-changing environment. People who share our strong values. Team players with a collaborative mindset and a passion to deliver high standards for our clients. Lifelong learners. High performers. Globally minded people who aspire to work in a transforming industry, where excellence, speed, and quality count.
* We cultivate a learning environment, dedicating tools and resources to ensure we remain at the forefront of mobility. Our people enjoy an average of more than 22 hours of online and in\-person training within FORVIA University (five campuses around the world)
* We offer a multicultural environment that values diversity and international collaboration. We believe that diversity is a strength. To create an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity create real value for the company, we have adopted gender diversity targets and inclusion action plans.
* Achieving CO2 Net Zero as a pioneer of the automotive industry is a priority: In June 2022, Forvia became the first global automotive group to be certified with the new SBTI Net\-Zero Standard (the most ambitious standard of SBTi), aligned with the ambition of the 2015 Paris Agreement of limiting global warming to 1\.5°C. Three principles guide our action: use less, use better and use longer, with a focus on recyclability and circular economy.


**Why join us**
 FORVIA, a global automotive technology supplier, comprises the complementary technology and industrial strengths of Faurecia and HELLA.
   

  

 With over 137 500 people, including more than 12,000 R\&D engineers across 40\+ countries, FORVIA provides a unique and comprehensive approach to the automotive challenges of today and tomorrow. Composed of 6 business groups and a strong IP portfolio of over 12,400 patents, FORVIA is focused on becoming the preferred innovation and integration partner for OEMs worldwide.
   

  

 In 2025, the Group achieved a consolidated revenue of 26\.2 billion euros prior to IFRS 5\. FORVIA SE is listed on the Euronext Paris market under the FRVIA mnemonic code and is a component of the SBF 120 index.

**About Our Team**
 The Customer Value Lead will sits within Journal Operations and is responsible for accelerating key strategic projects for Journal Operations, drive the right process and governance to drive Innovation across organization and contribute to development of key enablers such as learning ecosystem. .
   

  

**About The Role**
 Focused on core customer problems and an AI first mindset, the Customer Value Lead is accountable for driving the innovation initiatives, discovery, and value realisation of initiatives — including intelligent automation and Product capabilities — across end to end publishing processes.
   

  

 Acting as a strategic thought partner and accelerator for innovation, this role strengthens the quality of ideas and increases their likelihood of successful progression by challenging assumptions, quantifying value, surfacing risks and dependencies, connecting opportunities across domains, and providing structure and direction throughout discovery, product shaping, and implementation.Working closely with Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, and vendor teams, the role orchestrates delivery of prioritized initiatives across multiple stakeholders, resolves dependencies and blockers, and provides governance, decision\-making structure, and visibility to leadership.
   

  

 The role can also involve defining and tracking metrics and creating benefits frameworks, using experimentation and data to validate assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions, and ensures right prioritization of individual initiatives to deliver on our strategy.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Innovation Strategy, Initiatives \& Discovery**
* Assess new opportunities, establishing clear criteria for progression and prioritisation based on customer impact, business value, risk, and effort.
* Lead or consult on discovery activity, challenging the problem definition to ensure the right problem is being solved before investment is made.
* Define target outcomes, identify affected users and stakeholders, and quantify the potential impact of opportunities under consideration.
* Surface risks, assumptions, and dependencies early, and determine what needs to be validated (e.g. through research, prototyping, or experimentation) before an initiative progresses.


**Product Management \& Solution Shaping**
* Translate validated opportunities into clear product/solution requirements, defining journeys, outcomes, and success measures.
* Support prioritisation of requirements and features in partnership with Product and Technology, ensuring business value and customer impact drive sequencing.
* Work with Product and Technology teams through elaboration, design, and implementation, providing business input and decisions at key stages.
* Ensure delivered solutions remain aligned to the original business problem and intended outcomes, escalating and course\-correcting where scope or design drifts.
* Own business\-side delivery oversight, coordinating UAT, release readiness, and go\-live activities to ensure a smooth transition into live service.


**Intelligent Automation**
* Shape the roadmap for intelligent automation within the product, identifying where AI\-driven capabilities can most effectively support user tasks, decisions, or interactions, and building the business case for each opportunity.
* Partner with Technology and Design teams to define the underlying requirements — the logic, data and knowledge sources, and integration/API needs the capability depends on — along with the guardrails, escalation paths, and human\-in\-the\-loop or assisted\-service touchpoints needed to manage risk, edge cases, and complex scenarios.
* Establish clear quality and performance measures (such as accuracy, containment or resolution rates, error/escalation rates, and customer satisfaction), and agree the testing, validation, and release criteria required before deployment.
* Once live, monitor performance and usage data, incorporate user feedback, and drive continuous optimisation and retraining to ensure the capability keeps pace with changing needs and continues to deliver measurable value.


**Orchestration, Governance \& Delivery Acceleration**
* Act as the central connective point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, vendor, and other partner teams, resolving dependencies and unblocking delivery.
* Identify blockers and risks early, establish clear ownership, and drive decisions to keep initiatives moving when they span multiple teams.
* Establish and maintain operational governance to ensure enhancements align with service policies, compliance requirements, and readiness standards, communicating major changes and contingency plans clearly


- 

**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Value Realisation**
* Act as the central coordination point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, and other partner teams, facilitating alignment on priorities, service impacts, and adoption readiness across initiatives.
* Champion change enablement and adoption, ensuring capabilities are understood and effectively embedded into ways of working, and build a cross\-functional stakeholder community to share performance insights, lessons learned, and improvement opportunities.
* Establish baselines, targets, and KPI frameworks for initiatives, and maintain a benefits/impact monitoring framework to track value realised against the original business case.
* Track adoption, performance, quality, and other operational outcomes, using data and structured experimentation to test assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions.
* Escalate operational risks, dependency conflicts, and delivery blockers through appropriate governance channels, and connect insights and outcomes across initiatives to identify opportunities for reuse or broader strategic alignment.


**Requirements**
* 6–10 years of experience in service operations, digital support operations, automation initiatives, or business\-facing roles within technology\-enabled environments.
* Demonstrated experience delivering measurable improvements in service efficiency, operational performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Experience identifying and evaluating automation or digital enhancement opportunities from a business and service impact perspective.
* Strong understanding of customer support operations, including case management workflows, escalation models, SLAs, and service risk considerations.
* Experience partnering with Product and Technology teams to translate operational priorities into structured business requirements and improvement initiatives.

 Acting as a strategic thought partner and accelerator for innovation, this role strengthens the quality of ideas and increases their likelihood of successful progression by challenging assumptions, quantifying value, surfacing risks and dependencies, connecting opportunities across domains, and providing structure and direction throughout discovery, product shaping, and implementation.Working closely with Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, and vendor teams, the role orchestrates delivery of prioritized initiatives across multiple stakeholders, resolves dependencies and blockers, and provides governance, decision\-making structure, and visibility to leadership.
   

  

 The role can also involve defining and tracking metrics and creating benefits frameworks, using experimentation and data to validate assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions, and ensures right prioritization of individual initiatives to deliver on our strategy.

**Innovation Strategy, Initiatives \& Discovery**

* Own business\-side delivery oversight, coordinating UAT, release readiness, and go\-live activities to ensure a smooth transition into live service.


**Intelligent Automation**

* Partner with Technology and Design teams to define the underlying requirements — the logic, data and knowledge sources, and integration/API needs the capability depends on — along with the guardrails, escalation paths, and human\-in\-the\-loop or assisted\-service touchpoints needed to manage risk, edge cases, and complex scenarios.
* Establish clear quality and performance measures (such as accuracy, containment or resolution rates, error/escalation rates, and customer satisfaction), and agree the testing, validation, and release criteria required before deployment.
* Once live, monitor performance and usage data, incorporate user feedback, and drive continuous optimisation and retraining to ensure the capability keeps pace with changing needs and continues to deliver measurable value.


**Orchestration, Governance \& Delivery Acceleration**
* Act as the central connective point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, Editorial, vendor, and other partner teams, resolving dependencies and unblocking delivery.
* Identify blockers and risks early, establish clear ownership, and drive decisions to keep initiatives moving when they span multiple teams.
* Establish and maintain operational governance to ensure enhancements align with service policies, compliance requirements, and readiness standards, communicating major changes and contingency plans clearly


- 

**Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Value Realisation**
* Act as the central coordination point across Business, Product, Technology, Operations, CX, and other partner teams, facilitating alignment on priorities, service impacts, and adoption readiness across initiatives.
* Champion change enablement and adoption, ensuring capabilities are understood and effectively embedded into ways of working, and build a cross\-functional stakeholder community to share performance insights, lessons learned, and improvement opportunities.
* Establish baselines, targets, and KPI frameworks for initiatives, and maintain a benefits/impact monitoring framework to track value realised against the original business case.
* Track adoption, performance, quality, and other operational outcomes, using data and structured experimentation to test assumptions and inform go/no\-go decisions.
* Escalate operational risks, dependency conflicts, and delivery blockers through appropriate governance channels, and connect insights and outcomes across initiatives to identify opportunities for reuse or broader strategic alignment.


**Requirements**

* Experience identifying and evaluating automation or digital enhancement opportunities from a business and service impact perspective.

 As a Senior Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for overall technical delivery as part of large\-scale software solutions at enterprise level. You will lead functional and technical teams on the project located across shores guiding and mentoring junior team members and collaborating to understand the functional requirements. You will respond to new sales or proposals and support end\-to\-end delivery of the project along with estimations and planning.
   

  

 You will be responsible for managing the design, development, and deployment of large\-scale system implementations at an enterprise level. You will be responsible for independently managing the team and guiding team members at different levels through their career path, work through technical leads across shores to manage implementation of the functional requirements and implement them on platforms like Guidewire and Majesco. You will own the end\-to\-end delivery of the project from estimations, planning, and execution. You would also be responsible for managing the status and end to end delivery of the final product.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Deloitte's Health Care Provider practice helps hospital and health system clients design, implement, optimize, and stabilize Epic and other electronic medical record (EMR) platforms as part of broader digital and clinical transformation programs. We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead our offshore Epic delivery teams, acting as the connective layer between onshore client\-facing leadership and our India\-based build, testing, and support teams.
   

  

 This is a delivery leadership role — you will own workstream execution, team management, and quality for one or more Epic modules/applications across engagements, while helping mature our offshore Epic capability.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead offshore delivery for Epic EMR workstreams (e.g., Ambulatory, Inpatient/ClinDoc, Cadence, Prelude/ADT, Willow, Beacon, OpTime, ASAP, Grand Central, Radiant, HIM, or Payer platforms) across implementation, optimization, upgrade, and application managed services (AMS) engagements.

* Own workstream execution — build plans, Incidents/SRs, small and large enhancements— ensuring on\-time, on\-quality delivery against client\-agreed scope and adhering to client’s processes.
* Partner with client and onshore engagement leadership to translate client requirements, workflows, and design decisions into actionable offshore work packages.
* Drive governance and reporting — status updates, RAID logs, capacity/utilization tracking, and escalation management across time zones.
* Ensure Epic build quality and compliance with client governance, Epic's own standards (e.g., Epic's Storyboard/Chronicles environment practices), and Deloitte delivery methodology.
* Support pre\-sales and proposal efforts , including offshore staffing plans, effort estimation, and delivery approach for new pursuits.
* Contribute to offshore practice development — recruiting, training curricula, reusable accelerators, and knowledge management.
* Manage stakeholder relationships across US/onshore client teams, and internal Deloitte leadership.


**Required Qualifications**
* 15\+ years of total IT/consulting experience, with 6\+ years dedicated to Epic EMR implementation, optimization, or support.
* Proven experience managing offshore or globally distributed teams on Epic engagements, including cross\-time\-zone delivery models.
* Hands\-on depth in at least one major Epic application area (Ambulatory, Inpatient, ClinDoc, Cadence/Prelude, Willow, Beacon, OpTime, ASAP, Radiant, HIM, or Tapestry/Payer), with working knowledge of adjacent modules.
* Active or recent Epic certification(s) in a relevant module (certification lapses acceptable if recency and/or depth are demonstrated).
* Experience across the full ITSM delivery activities: Incidents, SRs, changes, tasks and projects/enhancements with associated build, unit/integration/UAT testing, cutover planning, go\-live support, and post\-live stabilization activities
* Strong people leadership — staffing, performance reviews, coaching, and building bench strength in an offshore delivery center.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to onshore client and Deloitte leadership.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Health Informatics, Life Sciences, or related); Master's preferred.
* Flexibility to work overlapping hours with US client teams as needed.

* Prior experience at a Big 4 or major healthcare IT consulting firm.
* Multiple Epic certifications or other EMR experience
* Exposure to Epic upgrades (e.g., version migrations), or multi\-hospital rollouts.
* Familiarity with adjacent healthcare IT domains: HL7/FHIR interoperability, revenue cycle, clinical informatics, or population health.

title: Chief Administrative Officer

**Meenakshi Sundararajan Group of Institutions (MSGI)** 




 📍 Kodambakkam, Chennai
 



  





 Meenakshi Sundararajan Group of Institutions (MSGI) is looking for an experienced and dynamic \*Chief Administrative Officer (CAO)\* to lead the overall administrative and operational functions of our Kodambakkam campus.
 



  





 The CAO will play a key leadership role in ensuring
 **efficient campus operations, infrastructure management, safety, security, facilities, procurement, vendor management and administrative governance.** 




  





 🔹 POSITION
 



  





 \*Designation:\* Chief Administrative Officer (CAO)
 



 \*Location:\* Kodambakkam, Chennai
 



 \*Department:\* Administration
 



 \*Reporting To:\* Secretary / Management
 



 \*Employment Type:\* Full\-time
 



 \*Experience:\* 15\+ years in senior administration / institutional operations / facilities management
 



  





  🎯 ROLE PURPOSE
 



  





 The CAO will be responsible for the overall administrative and operational excellence of the MSGI campus.
 



  





 The role requires a hands\-on leader who can translate Management decisions into effective execution, establish strong systems and SOPs, lead administrative teams, ensure campus readiness and maintain high standards of
 **safety, discipline, service quality and operational efficiency** 
 .
 



  





  🔹 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





  1\. Institutional Administration
 



  





 \* Lead the overall administrative operations of the campus.
 



 \* Develop and implement administrative policies, SOPs, systems and processes.
 



 \* Ensure timely execution of Management decisions and institutional requirements.
 



 \* Coordinate effectively with the Principal, COO, HODs and functional heads.
 



 \* Monitor administrative performance and resolve operational challenges.
 



  





  2\. Infrastructure \& Facilities
 



  





 \* Oversee campus infrastructure, buildings, classrooms, laboratories and common facilities.
 



 \* Manage civil, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, DG, lift, water and other facility\-related services.
 



 \* Establish preventive maintenance systems and ensure timely breakdown resolution.
 



 \* Monitor renovation, refurbishment and infrastructure projects.
 



  





  3\. Safety \& Security
 



  





 \* Lead campus safety, security and emergency preparedness initiatives.
 



 \* Supervise security operations, access control, CCTV and visitor management.
 



 \* Monitor fire, electrical, building and workplace safety.
 



 \* Conduct regular campus inspections and ensure closure of safety observations.
 



 \* Develop and periodically review emergency response procedures.
 



  





  4\. Housekeeping \& Campus Services
 



  





 \* Oversee housekeeping, cleanliness, hygiene and campus presentation.
 



 \* Monitor manpower deployment, attendance, discipline and service standards.
 



 \* Establish inspection checklists and service\-level standards.
 



 \* Ensure timely resolution of cleanliness and facility\-related complaints.
 



  





  5\. Procurement \& Vendor Management
 



  





 \* Oversee administrative procurement and vendor coordination.
 



 \* Review quotations, comparative statements, purchase requirements and service contracts.
 



 \* Develop and manage an approved vendor network.
 



 \* Monitor vendor performance, AMC contracts, service quality and timelines.
 



 \* Support cost\-effective and transparent procurement.
 



  





  6\. Budget \& Cost Control
 



  





 \* Prepare and monitor the annual administrative budget.
 



 \* Track infrastructure, maintenance, security, housekeeping and procurement expenditure.
 



 \* Identify opportunities for cost optimization.
 



 \* Ensure effective utilization of institutional resources.
 



  





  7\. Asset \& Inventory Management
 



  





 \* Maintain effective systems for asset and inventory management.
 



 \* Ensure periodic physical verification and proper documentation.
 



 \* Monitor utilization, movement, maintenance and replacement of institutional assets.
 



  





  8\. Team Leadership
 



  





 \* Lead administrative, maintenance, security, housekeeping and support teams.
 



 \* Establish clear responsibilities, accountability and performance standards.
 



 \* Conduct periodic performance reviews and support team development.
 



 \* Coordinate with HR on manpower, discipline, attendance and employee\-related matters.
 



  





 9\. MIS \& Management Reporting
 



  





 \* Prepare and present periodic Administrative MIS to Management.
 



 \* Track maintenance, safety, procurement, vendors, manpower, expenditure and pending activities.
 



 \* Maintain action trackers for Management instructions.
 



 \* Escalate critical issues and delays with appropriate recommendations.
 



  





 10\. Institutional Events \& Special Projects
 



  





 \* Provide administrative and logistical support for admissions, examinations, events, conferences, inspections and institutional programmes.
 



 \* Coordinate campus readiness, security, facilities, housekeeping and logistics.
 



 \* Undertake special projects and responsibilities assigned by Management.
 



  





 🎓 QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCE
 



  





 \*Essential:\*
 



  





 \* Graduate / Postgraduate degree in Administration, Management, Engineering, Law or a related discipline.
 



 \* \*15\+ years of relevant experience\*, with significant experience in a senior administrative / operations leadership role.
 



 \* Strong experience in infrastructure, facilities, maintenance, safety, security, procurement and vendor management.
 



 \* Experience managing multiple administrative and support\-service teams.
 



  





 \*Preferred:\*
 



  





 \* Experience in an educational institution, university, hospital, corporate campus or large organization.
 



 \* MBA / PG qualification in Management or a related field.
 



 \* Strong exposure to budgeting, MIS, SOP development and process improvement.
 



 \* Experience with ERP / digital administrative systems.
 



  





  KEY SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES
 



  





 \* Strategic \& Operational Administration
 



 \* Campus \& Facilities Management
 



 \* Infrastructure \& Maintenance
 



 \* Safety \& Risk Management
 



 \* Security Management
 



 \* Procurement \& Vendor Management
 



 \* Budget \& Cost Control
 



 \* Team Leadership
 



 \* Crisis \& Emergency Management
 



 \* Stakeholder Management
 



 \* Negotiation \& Decision Making
 



 \* MIS \& Reporting
 



 \* SOP \& Process Development
 



 \* Problem Solving
 



 \* Strong Execution \& Follow\-through
 



  





  📊 KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS
 



  





 The CAO will be evaluated on:
 



  





 \* Operational efficiency of the campus
 



 \* Infrastructure and maintenance performance
 



 \* Safety and security standards
 



 \* Housekeeping and campus service quality
 



 \* Procurement efficiency and vendor performance
 



 \* Budget adherence and cost optimization
 



 \* Administrative team productivity
 



 \* Asset and inventory control
 



 \* Timeliness and accuracy of MIS
 



 \* Execution of Management instructions
 



 \* Timely closure of administrative issues
 



  





 👤 IDEAL CANDIDATE
 



  





 We are looking for a \*mature, proactive and hands\-on administrative leader\* who can independently manage a large institutional environment, anticipate operational requirements, solve problems quickly and build systems that improve efficiency.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have strong leadership, communication, negotiation, decision\-making and execution skills, along with the ability to work closely with senior Management and academic leadership.
 



  





 📩 INTERESTED CANDIDATES
 



  





 Candidates with relevant experience and a strong background in institutional administration / campus operations / facilities management are invited to apply.
 



  





 Location: Kodambakkam, Chennai
 



 Position: Chief Administrative Officer (CAO)
 



  




* Join MSGI and contribute to building a professionally managed, safe, efficient and future\-ready institutional campus.

description:
**Work Locations: Bangalore \& Chennai** 




  





**Job Description Summary:** 




 The RCM Training Lead will lead and scale the training charter for a multi\-geography RCM delivery organization. This role is responsible for strategizing, implementing, and governing the effectiveness of new hire, lateral, and leadership training across Provider verticals, ensuring that business needs, client SLAs, compliance standards, and employee development goals are met. This role requires a strategic thinker with strong people management skills and domain expertise in US healthcare revenue cycle processes.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Training Strategy \& Frameworks:** 



* Own the RCM training charter across geographies (onboarding ( New hires \& Laterals), role\-based, refresher, upskilling).
* Partner with business leaders to forecast training needs and build training calendars.
* Design and standardize SOP\-driven, competency\-based training modules across client accounts.
* Lead a team of RCM trainers and instructional designers; coach and mentor them.
* Implement digital learning (LMS, simulations, eLearning) and measure training ROI.
* Create and maintain dashboards for training effectiveness, speed\-to\-proficiency, and knowledge retention.
* Ensure audit\-readiness of training documentation and process certifications.
* Support transitions, client ramp\-ups, and strategic capability\-building projects.
* Develop \& execute annual training roadmaps aligned to client SLAs and internal KPIs.
* Institutionalize “Training Need Identification (TNI)” and “Training Need Analysis (TNA)” frameworks across business units.
* Lead process maturity assessments and training diagnostics to define capability building projects.



  





**Team Management** 



* Lead and mentor a team of 2–10 trainers, content developers, and facilitators across Indian geographies.
* Conduct trainer calibration, TTT (Train\-the\-Trainer) programs, and quarterly capability reviews.
* Drive a Trainer Productivity Index (sessions held vs. business impact measured).
* Publish a quarterly L\&D Scorecard to leadership and stakeholders.



  





**Curriculum, Content \& Technology:** 



* Create and oversee the development of interactive and blended learning modules using:
* Articulate 360, Adobe Captivate, Rise, Camtasia, Vyond ( Any two from the list is Mandatory)
* eLearning and SCORM\-based content
* Manage LMS deployment and compliance (preferably Talent LMS, Moodle, Workday, etc.).
* Collaborate with SMEs and operations to build role\-specific learning paths, simulations, job aids, and explainer videos.



  





**Measurement, ROI \& Governance:** 



* Create a learning effectiveness model using Kirkpatrick’s Evaluation Levels and Phillips ROI Methodology.
* Track and publish data on: Time to Proficiency, First Pass Accuracy (FPA), Quality vs. Pre/Post Training Intervention, Attrition post\-training (30/60/90\-day window)
* Prepare for and participate in client audits, \& internal compliance assessments.



  





**Client and Business Engagement:** 



* Represent L\&D in client onboarding and transition calls to design training solutions for new processes.
* Lead strategic initiatives like: Voice Neutralization Programs, Cross\-skilling \& Re\-skilling Models, Speed to proficiency \& Bootcamps
* Partner with HR and TA on the Hiring to reduce drop\-offs and improve hire quality.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor's/Master’s degree in Healthcare, Management, or Learning \& Development.
* CPC, CCS certification is mandatory
* Minimum 6–10 years of Medical Coding Experience with at least 4 years in training leadership.
* Proven expertise in training design, delivery, and measurement across US Healthcare (Providers).
* Certifications preferred: AHM 250, Six Sigma, Kirkpatrick Bronze, Instructional Design
* Strong stakeholder management, strategic planning, and analytical skills.
* Ability to influence cross\-functional leaders, present to clients, and drive change.

title: Project SCM Manager - HVDC
description:
**The Opportunity**
 HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) is a product group in Hitachi Energy, which develops, manufactures and sells DC transmission systems on a global market. HVDC technology is used to transmit electricity over long distances and for power transmission via submarine cables. It is also used to connect power systems. The HVDC market for large scale transmission and offshore wind is booming as an enabler for the global energy transitions. All these projects are classified as very critical infrastructures and hence cyber security requirements, and standard compliance is very high. Hitachi Energy is seeking Project Managers – Supply Chain for Chennai location. This is a great opportunity to apply your passion for project management to manage million\-dollar projects!
   

  

 This is an individual contributor role, responsible for SCM (Supply Chain Management) in the Project, reporting to the Regional Supply Chain Manager while supporting the project director. If you like complex projects, business challenges, have a curious mind, and have a problem\-solving attitude, take the opportunity to join a World Technology Leader Company. Experience the great feeling from managing the SCM scope of large projects close to the end customer. We are interested to learn more about you and what you can contribute with so don’t hesitate to apply even though you don´t meet all requirements. A team with great cooperation and with diverse background is waiting for you to join.
   

  

**How You'll Make An Impact**
* In this role you will be Project Manager within the HVDC SCM project and responsible for the procurement activities in our HVDC projects.
* You will be part of the HVDC Project Core team for the projects you manage.
* In this role, you will coordinate across multiple global regions with engineers, controllers, project planners, logisticians, quality professionals, buyers, and suppliers to ensure that equipment is procured and delivered on time, within budget, and within standard.
* You will be responsible for ensuring that all key personnel within the project, global supply chain, the HVDC organization, and the client are aware of any risks and opportunities within project supply chain.
* During the project execution Project SCM need to ensure relentless execution with proactive planning and follow\-up all equipment delivers with our suppliers and internal stakeholders. Project SCM to solve upcoming quality constraints or deficiencies with the supplier equipment deliveries.
* Contribute to vendor list management by providing Supplier Performance data. Ensure that our suppliers comply with the laws, regulations, standards, certificates and directives that Hitachi Energy requires from their suppliers.
* You will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your Background**
* You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering with preferably 12\+ years relevant work experience and master's in business administration is added advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to manage the supply chain management needs of multi\-million dollar projects.
* Strong organizational and planning skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Proactively address business demands in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to prioritize and allocate resources to align with department and company goals.
* Preferred CPSM or PMP certifications, Lean Six Sigma, SAP Experience, Documentation Management Systems, Power BI and proficiency with Microsoft Office.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to create strong working relationships.

title: Global Billing Operations - Manager
description:
**Background**
 State Street has established a Global Billing Function under Controllership, which is responsible for client billing set up and invoicing across all business lines and geographies globally at State Street. Organizationally, it combines all groups performing these activities globally, and also includes centers residing in State Street Shared Service locations in Poland, India and China. Billing Organization owns aspects of business\-as\-usual activities within billing areas and also drives process improvements and automation.
   

  

**Basic Purpose Of Job**
 The Invoice Review Lead will be responsible for all aspects of the invoice billing process including invoice raising, OOPS (Out of Pocket Expenses) invoicing, and invoice review across State Street global businesses spread across countries \& regions.
   

  

 The Invoice Review Lead will manage a large team with a complex engagement model on a day\-to\-day basis. The individual will be directly responsible for daily management of accurate, consistent, and timely invoice deliverables. This individual will provide subject matter expertise in invoice preparation and review including receivables analytics. The Invoice Review Lead will also be responsible for managing State Street Global Advisors’ invoice production and review.
   

  

 In addition to Business As Usual (BAU) responsibilities as described above, this role will also be involved in process re\-engineering, standardization, and automation efforts.
   

  

 Responsibilities:\-
   

  

**Business As Usual (BAU) Activities**

title: Manager II Program Management, Global Catalog Operations
description:
**Description**
 Amazon.com operates in a global eCommerce environment without boundaries, and operates a diverse set of businesses worldwide, including Retail, third party marketplaces, eCommerce platforms, web services for developers.
   

  

 The Amazon product catalog is a set of records; each record being a set of facts describing a physical or digital product. These records are often organized by defined relationships (e.g. variations such as different sizes of the same shoe). Our ability to provide a good product discovery experience and empower our customers to make well informed purchase decisions is dependent on the quality of our product catalog. In a high quality catalog, every product is described with a complete, structured, accurate and correctly normalized set of facts. Every product is represented by a unique record appropriately related to one another.
   

  

 The Global catalog operations (GCO) team is part of Amazon Selection \& Catalog services (ASCS) teams in India focus on leveraging human intelligence, external or internal, to measure and improve the quality of the catalog: Global catalog operations (GCO) charter is to make Catalog engineering programs more effective by providing expert human judgment. Catalog Operations from its inception has been partnering with engineering teams to run programs focused on improving the data quality of catalog in all market places.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced people leader to join our rapidly growing team as a Manager II, Program Management. In this role you will build and lead a team of SMEs, auditors and Program Managers responsible for developing insights and eliminating quality defects that affect business metrics. You will own a portfolio of catalog quality programs rather than a single workstream, set the direction and mechanisms your team operates by, and be accountable for the aggregate delivery and business outcomes of the programs under you. As part of this role, you will 1\) hire, develop, and lead a team of auditors, SMES and program managers, growing the bench and the capability of the function, 2\) own a portfolio of quality programs, prioritizing across competing initiatives and allocating capacity to the highest impact opportunities, 3\) set the operating mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that make your team's programs measurable and repeatable, and 4\) work collaboratively across partner teams (Science, PMs, Engineering, Business, etc.) and represent catalog quality program management to senior leadership across GCO and partner orgs.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**As a Manager II, Program Management You Will**
* Build, lead, and develop a team of auditors, SMEs and program managers, owning hiring, performance management, coaching, and career growth
* Own catalog quality programs, setting priorities across competing initiatives and allocating team capacity to the highest impact work
* Establish the operating mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that ensure your team's programs deliver measurable business and operational outcomes
* Be accountable for the aggregate delivery and business/operational metrics of the programs under your team
* Drive quantitative, data\-oriented decision making across the portfolio and champion the adoption of technology solutions and process improvements
* Communicate program progress, risks, and results to senior leadership, ensuring transparency and alignment with key business goals
* Identify systemic gaps across process areas and mobilize your team and stakeholders to resolve them
* Serve as an escalation point and senior partner for in\-house and customer teams across Science, Engineering, Product, and Business
* Ensure effective risk controls are developed and maintained across programs, with corrective actions that keep commitments on track and minimize losses
* Develop and influence new ideas, establishing procedures and practices that promote long\-term, scalable solutions in dynamic environments
* Drive continuous improvement and decision\-making strategies across the team and the broader function


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* 5\+ years of team management experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience in data mining, data management, reporting, and SQL queries

 **500\+ employees** 
 , each possessing rich field expertise. Metayb focuses on fostering seamless customer experiences, enhancing operational efficiency, and deriving actionable insights. By harnessing the power of emerging technologies, Metayb aims to be the unparalleled choice for global customers, delivering strategic goals effectively within a digital\-first ecosystem of value creation.
   

  

 Our key areas of expertise lie in
 **Digital Transformation, Data Science, SAP Implementation, Workflow Automation, Dashboarding, Visualization, Finance, and Supply Chain Services** 
 . We strongly aspire to venture into
 **IoT, AI/ML, and Virtual Reality** 
 . Metayb endeavours to be best\-in\-class across digital solutions, infrastructure, and product engineering.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Supply Chain Manager** 
 to manage and coordinate end\-to\-end
 **logistics, shipment planning, transportation, dispatch, and supply chain operations** 
 across the Middle East and Africa region, with a particular focus on
 **Saudi Arabia and Egypt** 
 .
   

  

 The role will focus on ensuring smooth shipment execution, timely deliveries, transportation management, supply chain visibility, and effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders. The position will work closely with the
 **Head of Logistics** 
 to provide operational support, maintain critical logistics information, monitor shipment progress, and proactively manage delivery risks and operational challenges.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in
 **logistics, transportation, dispatch, warehousing, and supply chain operations** 
 , along with strong SAP knowledge and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders across international markets.
   

  

 This role is based in
 **Chennai** 
 and operates on a
 **12:00 PM to 9:00 PM IST shift.**
 The working week is
 **Saturday to Thursday** 
 , with
 **Friday as the weekly off** 
 .
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 🔹 Shipment Planning \& Coordination
   

  

* Coordinate daily dispatch and shipment activities based on customer orders and delivery schedules.
* Plan and arrange transportation for shipments from factories to customer locations across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and other relevant Middle East and African markets.
* Work closely with the Head of Logistics to support day\-to\-day logistics planning, execution, and operational decision\-making.
* Act as an operational support and coordination point for the Head of Logistics, maintaining critical shipment, transportation, and logistics information.
* Ensure timely availability of vehicles, transportation resources, and logistics partners required for shipment execution.
* Maintain updated contact details and records of transport vendors, drivers, logistics partners, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Track shipments from dispatch through delivery and proactively identify, report, and resolve potential delays, disruptions, and delivery risks.
* Coordinate closely with warehouse teams to ensure packing, loading, documentation, and dispatch readiness.
* Maintain effective communication with internal teams and multi\-national stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of logistics operations.
* Maintain strong governance and visibility across the end\-to\-end supply chain and logistics process.
* Develop a strong understanding of business operations and ensure timely fulfilment of customer and business commitments.


 🔹 Transportation \& Logistics Management
   

  

* Manage and coordinate transportation activities across Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and other Middle East and African markets.
* Liaise with transport vendors, third\-party logistics providers, drivers, warehouses, factories, and destination teams to ensure smooth shipment execution.
* Monitor vehicle movement, shipment status, delivery schedules, and transportation performance.
* Proactively identify transportation risks and coordinate appropriate corrective actions to minimise delivery disruptions.
* Resolve transportation delays, vehicle availability issues, and delivery\-related challenges in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure effective coordination between factories, warehouses, transporters, drivers, customers, and destination teams.
* Support effective management of freight, transportation resources, shipment tracking, and delivery performance.
* Maintain accurate records of transportation activities, shipment status, delays, and operational issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve transportation efficiency, service levels, and supply chain performance.


 🔹 Supply Chain Operations \& SAP
   

  

* Leverage strong SAP knowledge to support logistics planning, shipment execution, reporting, and day\-to\-day supply chain operations.
* Ensure timely and accurate updates of shipment and logistics information within relevant systems.
* Monitor supply chain activities and maintain visibility across the order, dispatch, transportation, and delivery cycle.
* Prepare and maintain logistics and supply chain reports covering shipment status, delivery performance, delays, transportation activities, and operational risks.
* Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure accurate flow of information across the supply chain.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and support initiatives focused on process improvement, supply chain efficiency, and operational governance.
* Ensure adherence to established processes, controls, and governance requirements across logistics operations.


 🔹 Stakeholder \& Vendor Management
   

  

* Maintain strong relationships with transport vendors, logistics partners, warehouse teams, factory teams, customers, and internal stakeholders.
* Coordinate effectively with stakeholders across different countries, cultures, and time zones.
* Serve as a key coordination point between the Head of Logistics and operational stakeholders.

title: Head of Physiotherapy (Clinical Lead)
description:
ABOUT VECURA
   

 VeCura is a doctor\-led wellness and metabolic health clinic chain with 30\+ branches across Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, and more coming. We treat 35,000\+ clients a year through structured programmes combining lifestyle, diet, device and physiotherapy. Muscle health and mobility are becoming central to how we care for clients, and we're building that function from the ground up.
   

  

 THE ROLE
   

 You will own physiotherapy across the VeCura network. You'll design and standardise our Physio module and train every branch physiotherapist to deliver both consistently. You'll also be the public face of physiotherapy at VeCura, explaining movement, strength and healthy ageing on camera to a large social media audience.
   

  

 WHAT YOU'LL DO
   

 Clinical leadership
   

 • Own the Physio module in every VeCura programme: assessment battery, session protocols, progression rules and outcome measures
   

 • Co\-develop programmes with our medical team
   

 • Define contraindications, red flags and escalation pathways with the medical team, and keep protocols evidence\-based and clinically defensible
   

 • Audit protocol adherence and outcomes across branches, then fix the gaps
   

 Training and team building
   

 • Build the physio training curriculum: onboarding, module certification and periodic refreshers
   

 • Train and mentor branch physiotherapists, in person and virtually
   

 • Set quality standards and documentation norms, and run case reviews
   

 Content and communication
   

 • Appear regularly on VeCura's social media channels (reels, explainers, Q\&A, live sessions)
   

 • Work with the marketing team to plan, script and shoot content on mobility, strength, posture and healthy ageing
   

 • Keep all public messaging accurate, responsible and free of exaggerated claims
   

 • Support client education material and occasional workshops or corporate talks
   

  

 WHAT YOU BRING (MUST\-HAVE)
   

 • BPT required; MPT (Musculoskeletal, Neuro, Sports or Geriatrics) strongly preferred
   

 • 7\+ years of clinical experience, including at least 2 years leading or training a team of physiotherapists
   

 • Proven on\-camera experience: social media content, YouTube, TV, webinars or brand videos. Please share links.
   

 • Hands\-on experience with strength and balance rehab in older adults or musculoskeletal populations
   

 • Strong written and verbal communication in English and Tamil
   

 • Ability to turn clinical protocols into simple, repeatable SOPs that others can follow
   

  

 GOOD TO HAVE
   

 • Certification or training in fall\-prevention programmes (e.g., Otago), sarcopenia assessment or geriatric rehab
   

 • Familiarity with EMS, body composition analysis (InBody) or strength testing
   

 • Experience in a multi\-branch clinic chain or a structured training role
   

 • Telugu, Kannada or Malayalam knowledge is a plus
   

 • An existing personal following as a health educator
   

  

 WHAT WE OFFER
   

 • A leadership role building a network\-wide function from scratch
   

 • Direct access to corporate leadership and the medical team
   

 • A platform to build your public profile as a trusted physiotherapy voice
   

 • Competitive compensation

 Cost Management

 Workload Flexibility

 Networking \& Talent Development

title: AVP - Treasury PC
description:
Become part of Barclays as AVP \- Treasury Product Control, where purpose of the role is perform Analytical review of securities, fees and investment income for investment banking business. This includes understanding the nature of each business, explaining the movements in Balance sheet/P\&L, identifying the control gaps. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future \- we're creating.
   

  

**To Be Successful, In This Role You Should Have**
* Product control experience in Investment bank.
* In\-depth knowledge of Financial product and markets of the relevant governance control.
* Good understanding of end\-to\-end processes of an IB (Investment Banking) and associated controls.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills in both formal and informal settings and the ability to interact.
* Excellent time management skills and the ability to prioritize.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* CFA / Masters in Finance / Financial Engineering.
* Good control awareness and problem\-solving ability.
* Ability to work independently with a spectrum of people from junior finance staff to front office business heads.
* Mature and able to negotiate through difficult situations.
* Good influencing and negotiation skills and excellent communication and interpersonal skills.


 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based in our Chennai office.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To oversee the financial aspects of trading activities, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the bank's trading book, maintenance of compliance with regulatory requirements, and provision of insights into trading performance.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Reconciliation of daily profit and loss (P\&L) figures for trading desks to ensure they align with the valued positions in the trading book, investigating and resolving discrepancies between P\&L figures to ensure they reflect the true economic value of the trading portfolio.
* Support the identification, assessment, and mitigation of trading risks, and report on these financial risks to senior colleagues.
* Maintenance and analysis of the bank’s trading data, ensuring its accuracy, completeness and consistency, and provision of insights to traders and senior colleagues on trading performance.
* Preparation and submission of regulatory reports to authorities, and provision of support to external audits including addressing auditor queries and ensuring trading activities are appropriately reflected in financial statements.
* Effective communication of complex financial information to traders, risk professionals, senior colleagues, and external stakeholders.
* Cross functional collaboration to ensure a coordinated approach to trading activities.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

* Candidate Must have production environment experience consisting of Global load balancing, Local load balancing, SSL acceleration, HTTP compression / caching, and DNS.
* Candidate Must have strong Networking Experience \- TCP / IP, Administration of networking hardware.
* Candidate Must have design and maintenance experience with complex Web hosting network architectures.
* Experience directly managing routers, switches, load balancers and SSL accelerators in a high\-availability infrastructure is required.
* Expert understanding of TCP as it pertains to packet inspection and network / application flows.
* Expert ability to troubleshoot issues and make recommendations for system changes, as needed, to resolve issues.
* must have integration / configuration / administration experience and possess a solid Network background including an understanding of switch, network routing, and firewall concepts.
* The Load Balancing Engineer must possess very strong troubleshooting skills as well as a strong TCP understanding as it pertains to packet inspection and TCP flow in the Network and Application flows.

* Deep understanding of network protocols (Routing / Switching)

* Communicate network architecture designs clearly and effectively to technical and non\-technical decision makers
* Perform security hardening of network systems.

 Graduation: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) / Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) / Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA)

 10\-18 years.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer / HOD
description:
**Company Description** 




 XSubRobotics is a next\-generation defence technology company and a joint venture between Planys Technologies, Krishna Defence and Allied Industries Limited and Conceptia Software Technologies Pvt. Ltd. XSub is building intelligent autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) and maritime robotic systems that give naval and security forces a real‑time, machine‑driven picture of the undersea battlespace. Inspired by the pace, ambition, and product mindset of modern defence innovators, we are designing persistent, long‑range AUVs, edge‑compute heavy payloads, and advanced undersea sensing that turn oceans into knowledgeable, navigable, and defendable environments. At XSub, engineers and researchers work like full‑stack product teams: shaping hydrodynamics and propulsion, architecting navigation and perception stacks, and building autonomy and mission‑systems software that must perform in GPS‑denied, low‑comms, high‑risk conditions. title: Manager – Financial Operations
description:
Management Level
   

  

 F
